english: Turns out I signed up for a lot of paperwork as well...
french: Au final, je dois m'occuper d'énormément de paperasse...
russian: Оказалось, что я подписалась ещё и на горы бумажной работы...
bulgarian: Turns out I signed up for a lot of paperwork as well...

english: I wanted to become a doctor so that I could help people.
french: J'ai voulu devenir docteure pour aider les gens. Mais je me suis aperçue qu'il y avait aussi beaucoup de paperasses...
russian: Я хотела стать докторшей, чтобы помогать людям. Оказалось, что я подписалась ещё и на горы бумажной работы...
bulgarian: I wanted to become a doctor so that I could help people.

english: It outlined a surprisingly modern sounding medical technique. I might make use of it myself.
french: Il décrivait une technique médicale étonnamment moderne. Je vais peut-être même m'en servir.
russian: Там описана удивительно современная медицинская техника. Может, сама её применю.
bulgarian: It outlined a surprisingly modern sounding medical technique. I might make use of it myself.

english: Eiland had me come by for consultation of an old scroll.
french: Eiland est venu me voir pour que je donne mon avis sur un ancien parchemin.
russian: Эйланд позвал меня проконсультироваться по старому свитку.
bulgarian: Eiland had me come by for consultation of an old scroll.

english: Balor can keep his secrets. All I need to know is that he ships medicine to people in need.
french: Je n'ai que faire des secrets de Balor. L'important, c'est de savoir qu'il fait parvenir les médicaments aux gens qui en ont besoin.
russian: Балор пусть хранит свои секреты. Мне достаточно знать, что он отправляет лекарства нуждающимся.
bulgarian: Balor can keep his secrets. All I need to know is that he ships medicine to people in need.

english: How are you, [Ari]?
french: Comment te sens-tu, [Ari] ?
russian: Как ты, [Ari]?
bulgarian: How are you, [Ari]?

english: Of all the places Juniper could have put her bathhouse, she had to put it next door.
french: Il a fallu que Juniper ouvre ses bains, pile à côté de ma clinique.
russian: Из всех мест, где Джунипер могла открыть купальню, она выбрала соседний участок.
bulgarian: Of all the places Juniper could have put her bathhouse, she had to put it next door.

english: Except when I can hear that laugh of hers through the wall...
french: Sauf quand j'entends son rire distinctif de l'autre côté du mur...
russian: Если не считать её смех, который я слышу через стену...
bulgarian: Except when I can hear that laugh of hers through the wall...

english: I'll say this for Juniper... she's done a wonderful job reimagining this place. It's very calming.
french: Pour sa défense, Juniper a fait un travail remarquable en restaurant ces bains. C'est très relaxant.
russian: Надо отдать должное Джунипер... она прекрасно переосмыслила это место. Тут очень спокойно.
bulgarian: I'll say this for Juniper... she's done a wonderful job reimagining this place. It's very calming.

english: Dozy runs a tight bathhouse.
french: Dozy gère très bien les bains.
russian: Дрёма держит купальню в образцовом порядке.
bulgarian: Dozy runs a tight bathhouse.

english: Credit where credit is due...
french: Il faut bien reconnaître que...
russian: Отдам должное...
bulgarian: Credit where credit is due...

english: A good soak in the bath ought to straighten me right out.
french: Un bon bain chez Juniper et je serai à nouveau en pleine forme.
russian: Хорошая ванна должна меня выправить.
bulgarian: A good soak in the bath ought to straighten me right out.

english: I slept oddly and have a bit of tension in my neck...
french: J'ai mal dormi et je suis toute tendue au niveau du cou...
russian: Спала неудобно, теперь немного тянет шею...
bulgarian: I slept oddly and have a bit of tension in my neck...

english: It reminded me of the long treks I took with my father. He was an avid hiker, you know.
french: Ça me rappelle les longues excursions que je faisais avec mon père. C'était un grand randonneur, tu sais.
russian: Мне сразу вспоминаются долгие лесные походы с отцом. Знаешь, он ведь был заядлым походником.
bulgarian: It reminded me of the long treks I took with my father. He was an avid hiker, you know.

english: There's some kind of heady pine extract in the bath today.
french: Aujourd'hui, il y a un extrait de pin à l'arôme assez entêtant, dans le bain.
russian: В ванной сегодня какой-то дурманящий хвойный аромат.
bulgarian: There's some kind of heady pine extract in the bath today.

english: Which is quite frequently, might I add.
french: Ce qui arrive assez fréquemment.
russian: Отмечу: это случается довольно часто.
bulgarian: Which is quite frequently, might I add.

english: The trick to a pleasant bath is sneaking in while Juniper is asleep at the till.
french: Pour être tranquille aux bains, le secret est de se faufiler pendant que Juniper est endormie à la caisse.
russian: Рецепт хорошей бани — пробраться, пока Джунипер дремлет за кассой.
bulgarian: The trick to a pleasant bath is sneaking in while Juniper is asleep at the till.

english: I don't know why he bothers working with Juniper.
french: Je ne comprends pas pourquoi il s'embête à travailler avec Juniper.
russian: Не знаю, зачем он до сих пор держит Джунипер.
bulgarian: I don't know why he bothers working with Juniper.

english: That Dozy runs a wonderful bathhouse...
french: Dozy gère les bains comme personne...
russian: Дрёма так чудесно управляется с купальней...
bulgarian: That Dozy runs a wonderful bathhouse...

english: A day in the surf is just what I needed.
french: J'avais bien besoin d'une journée à la plage.
russian: День на волнах — это именно то, что мне было нужно.
bulgarian: A day in the surf is just what I needed.

english: Walking out into the surf certainly is bracing! But one gets used to the cold soon enough.
french: L'eau de mer est vraiment vivifiante ! Au début elle est froide, mais on s'habitue vite.
russian: Зайти в воду по пояс — это бодрит! Но к холоду быстро привыкаешь.
bulgarian: Walking out into the surf certainly is bracing! But one gets used to the cold soon enough.

english: Swimming is great exercise, you know! It's a low-impact, full-body workout.
french: Nager est très bon pour la santé, tu sais ! Ça fait travailler tout le corps !
russian: Плавание — отличная тренировка! Низкая нагрузка — и работа для всего тела.
bulgarian: Swimming is great exercise, you know! It's a low-impact, full-body workout.

english: Are you planning to do some laps, [Ari]?
french: Tu comptes faire quelques longueurs, [Ari] ?
russian: Планируешь поплавать, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Are you planning to do some laps, [Ari]?

english: But I'm at your service if that doesn't cut it.
french: Mais si malgré tout ça quelque chose ne va pas, je suis toujours là pour t'aider.
russian: Но если этого мало, я к твоим услугам.
bulgarian: But I'm at your service if that doesn't cut it.

english: There's no better medicine than sleeping, eating well, and living well.
french: Pour une bonne hygiène de vie, il faut bien dormir, bien manger et bien vivre.
russian: Нет лекарства лучше сна, правильного питания и здорового образа жизни.
bulgarian: There's no better medicine than sleeping, eating well, and living well.

english: Except for Juniper, it seems. She became quite irritable because I was "blocking her sun".
french: Sauf Juniper, visiblement. Elle s'est énervée parce que je lui « cachais le soleil ».
russian: Кроме Джунипер, похоже. Она раздражалась, что я «закрывала ей солнце».
bulgarian: Except for Juniper, it seems. She became quite irritable because I was "blocking her sun".

english: I'm happy to see you down on the Beach, [Ari]. Most people find it relaxing.
french: Je suis contente de te voir à la plage, [Ari]. La plupart des gens se détendent à la mer.
russian: Рада видеть тебя на пляже, [Ari]. Большинство находит это место умиротворяющим.
bulgarian: I'm happy to see you down on the Beach, [Ari]. Most people find it relaxing.

english: Did you eat a balanced breakfast, [Ari]? It sets the tone for your day. Here, take this.
french: Tu as pris un petit-déjeuner équilibré, [Ari] ? Ça conditionne toute ta journée. Tiens, c'est pour toi.
russian: У тебя был сбалансированный завтрак, [Ari]? Завтрак задаёт тон дню. Вот, возьми.
bulgarian: Did you eat a balanced breakfast, [Ari]? It sets the tone for your day. Here, take this.

english: That's what my father used to say, anyway.
french: C'est en tout cas ce que mon père disait toujours.
russian: Так говорил мой отец.
bulgarian: That's what my father used to say, anyway.

english: Though I don't know if I'd call a dozen boiled eggs "balanced".
french: Même si une douzaine d'œufs durs, ce n'est pas ce que j'appellerais un « petit-déjeuner équilibré ».
russian: Хотя дюжину варёных яиц я бы сбалансированными не назвала.
bulgarian: Though I don't know if I'd call a dozen boiled eggs "balanced".

english: A balanced breakfast opens the door to a balanced day.
french: Un petit-déjeuner équilibré est la clé d'une journée équilibrée.
russian: Сбалансированный завтрак — залог сбалансированного дня.
bulgarian: A balanced breakfast opens the door to a balanced day.

english: Be sure to get yourself some breakfast, [Ari]. A farmer needs it.
french: N'oublie pas de prendre un bon petit-déjeuner, [Ari]. C'est primordial quand on travaille à la ferme.
russian: Не забудь позавтракать, [Ari]. Фермеру это необходимо.
bulgarian: Be sure to get yourself some breakfast, [Ari]. A farmer needs it.

english: Make sure you eat something that will keep you warm today.
french: N'oublie pas de manger quelque chose qui te tiendra au corps, aujourd'hui.
russian: Обязательно съешь что-нибудь, чтобы тебе было тепло в течение дня.
bulgarian: Make sure you eat something that will keep you warm today.

english: As tempting as it is, a cup of =Coffee= is not a proper breakfast.
french: Même si c'est tentant, une simple tasse de =café= ne constitue pas un vrai petit-déjeuner.
russian: =Кофе= на завтрак звучит очень соблазнительно, но этого недостаточно.
bulgarian: As tempting as it is, a cup of =Coffee= is not a proper breakfast.

english: Have yourself some breakfast, [Ari]! Or at least take something to go. You never know when you'll need to renew your energy.
french: Prends un bon petit-déjeuner, [Ari] ! Ou au moins quelque chose sur le pouce. Tu ne sais jamais quand tu auras le temps de manger dans la journée.
russian: Присядь позавтракай, [Ari]! Или хотя бы возьми с собой. Никогда не знаешь, когда захочется подкрепиться.
bulgarian: Have yourself some breakfast, [Ari]! Or at least take something to go. You never know when you'll need to renew your energy.

english: I don't need to tell you, but be sure to bundle up when you go outside.
french: Je n'ai sûrement pas besoin de te le dire, mais pense à bien te couvrir quand tu sors.
russian: Не мне тебя учить, но одевайся потеплее, когда выходишь на улицу.
bulgarian: I don't need to tell you, but be sure to bundle up when you go outside.

english: Celine wants me to classify her father's sense of humor as a medical condition... it's tempting...
french: Céline veut que je classe le sens de l'humour de son père comme une vraie pathologie... J'avoue que c'est tentant...
russian: Селин просит классифицировать чувство юмора её отца как медицинское состояние... заманчиво...
bulgarian: Celine wants me to classify her father's sense of humor as a medical condition... it's tempting...

english: Good, good.
french: Bien, bien.
russian: Хорошо, хорошо.
bulgarian: Good, good.

english: Chin up. Turn your head to the side. Let me check your lymph nodes.
french: Lève le menton. Tourne la tête. Laisse-moi regarder tes ganglions lymphatiques.
russian: Подними подбородок. Поверни голову в сторону. Проверю лимфоузлы.
bulgarian: Chin up. Turn your head to the side. Let me check your lymph nodes.

english: Medical furniture isn't always easy to find, so I'm rather impressed by Merri's resourcefulness.
french: Le matériel médical n'est pas facile à trouver, mais je dois dire que je suis impressionnée par l'ingéniosité dont Merri fait preuve.
russian: Медицинскую мебель не так просто найти, так что я впечатлена находчивостью Мэрри.
bulgarian: Medical furniture isn't always easy to find, so I'm rather impressed by Merri's resourcefulness.

english: I inherited most of the furniture in this clinic, and the rest was furnished by Merri.
french: J'ai reçu la plus grande partie du mobilier de la clinique en héritage. Le reste vient de chez Merri.
russian: Большую часть мебели в клинике я унаследовала, остальное предоставила Мэрри.
bulgarian: I inherited most of the furniture in this clinic, and the rest was furnished by Merri.

english: How nice. Hello!
french: C'est très gentil. Eh bien, bonjour !
russian: Как мило. Привет!
bulgarian: How nice. Hello!

english: [Ari]! Hold on, I'll pull out your charts... Oh, you're just stopping by to say hello?
french: [Ari] ! Un instant, je sors ton dossier médical... Oh, tu passais juste dire bonjour ?
russian: [Ari]! Подожди, достану твою карточку... О, ты здесь просто поздороваться?
bulgarian: [Ari]! Hold on, I'll pull out your charts... Oh, you're just stopping by to say hello?

english: I was just thinking that the Clinic was a little quiet today.
french: J'étais justement en train de me dire que c'était assez calme à la clinique, aujourd'hui.
russian: Я как раз думала, что в клинике сегодня тихо.
bulgarian: I was just thinking that the Clinic was a little quiet today.

english: Oh, [Ari]! Thanks for stopping by.
french: Oh, [Ari] ! Merci de passer.
russian:
О, [Ari]! Спасибо, что

зашли

зашлазашёлзашло.
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]! Thanks for stopping by.

english: Take as long as you need to warm up in the Clinic.
french: Prends tout le temps nécessaire pour te réchauffer ici, à la clinique.
russian: Можешь погреться у меня в клинике сколько захочешь.
bulgarian: Take as long as you need to warm up in the Clinic.

english: How's the weather out there?
french: Quel temps fait-il, dehors ?
russian: Как там погодка?
bulgarian: How's the weather out there?

english: Stay warm out there, [Ari].
french: Couvre-toi bien, [Ari].
russian: Не замёрзни, [Ari].
bulgarian: Stay warm out there, [Ari].

english: I was going to keep the Clinic open today, but Hayden's right... even a doctor needs a day off every once in a while.
french: Je voulais ouvrir la clinique aujourd'hui, mais Hayden a raison... Même un médecin a le droit à un jour de repos, de temps en temps.
russian: Хотела сегодня держать клинику открытой, но Хейден прав... даже врачу иногда нужен выходной.
bulgarian: I was going to keep the Clinic open today, but Hayden's right... even a doctor needs a day off every once in a while.

english: I prescribe a pair of gloves and a fluffy pair of socks.
french: Je te prescris des gants et une paire de chaussettes bien chaudes.
russian: Выписываю перчатки и пушистые носки.
bulgarian: I prescribe a pair of gloves and a fluffy pair of socks.

english: It's cold out there, so I suggest keeping your extremities well insulated.
french: Il fait froid, alors fais en sorte de bien couvrir toutes les extrémités de ton corps.
russian: На улице холодно, советую утеплить конечности.
bulgarian: It's cold out there, so I suggest keeping your extremities well insulated.

english: Be sure to drop by if you get the sniffles, [Ari]. I'll get you sorted.
french: Si jamais tu t'enrhumes, viens me voir, [Ari]. Je te remettrai sur pieds en un rien de temps.
russian: Заглядывай, если схватишь насморк, [Ari]. Я тебя быстро вылечу.
bulgarian: Be sure to drop by if you get the sniffles, [Ari]. I'll get you sorted.

english: I'll need to stock up on willow bark extract before cold season hits.
french: Je vais devoir faire le plein d'écorce de saule avant le début de la saison froide.
russian: Надо пополнить запас экстракта ивы до наступления простудного сезона.
bulgarian: I'll need to stock up on willow bark extract before cold season hits.

english: I'm all for it.
french: Je suis pour, évidemment.
russian: Я только за.
bulgarian: I'm all for it.

english: Dell seems quite taken with the skeleton in my clinic. She's been asking Nora to get one for the General Store.
french: Dell semble adorer le squelette exposé dans ma clinique. Elle a demandé à Nora d'en installer un dans le magasin général.
russian: Делл очень заинтересовалась скелетом у меня в клинике. Теперь она просит поставить такого же в универмаге.
bulgarian: Dell seems quite taken with the skeleton in my clinic. She's been asking Nora to get one for the General Store.

english: Sometimes an extra portion of dinner is good for soaking up the wine.
french: Il faut parfois reprendre un peu de nourriture pour absorber le vin que tu bois.
russian: Иногда дополнительная порция ужина помогает впитать вино.
bulgarian: Sometimes an extra portion of dinner is good for soaking up the wine.

english: [Ari], are you taking care of yourself? Or do you have someone to take care of you?
french: [Ari], est-ce que tu prends bien soin de toi ? Ou est-ce que quelqu'un s'en occupe pour toi ?
russian: [Ari], ты заботишься о себе? Или есть кто-то, кто заботится о тебе?
bulgarian: [Ari], are you taking care of yourself? Or do you have someone to take care of you?

english: I'm so happy I came back to Mistria to practice medicine.
french: Je suis très heureuse d'être revenue à Mistria pour exercer.
russian: Я так рада, что для врачебной практики вернулась в Мистрию.
bulgarian: I'm so happy I came back to Mistria to practice medicine.

english: I suppose this drink has made me a bit nostalgic. I was just thinking about medical university in the Capital.
french: Cette boisson me rend nostalgique. Ça me rappelle mes études de médecine à la capitale.
russian: Пожалуй, выпивка заставляет тосковать по прошлому. Вспоминала медицинский университет в cтолице.
bulgarian: I suppose this drink has made me a bit nostalgic. I was just thinking about medical university in the Capital.

english: Be sure to get your eight hours of sleep, [Ari].
french: N'oublie pas de bien dormir tes huit heures, [Ari].
russian: Обязательно высыпайся, [Ari].
bulgarian: Be sure to get your eight hours of sleep, [Ari].

english: I don't need the help, but maybe you do, [Ari]?
french: Moi, je n'ai pas besoin de conseils, mais toi, [Ari] ?
russian: Мне помощь не нужна, а вот тебе, [Ari], может, пригодится?
bulgarian: I don't need the help, but maybe you do, [Ari]?

english: I always come out here to chat with Elsie, but the conversation always turns to romance.
french: Je viens souvent ici pour discuter avec Elsie, mais nous finissons toujours par parler de nos amours.
russian: Я всегда выхожу сюда поболтать с Элси, но разговор неизменно сворачивает к романтике.
bulgarian: I always come out here to chat with Elsie, but the conversation always turns to romance.

english: What exactly does Elsie think a doctor does?
french: Quelle idée Elsie se fait-elle de ma profession, au juste ?
russian: Как Элси себе представляет работу врача?
bulgarian: What exactly does Elsie think a doctor does?

english: Elsie loaned me a book she said was about medicine, but it's more about an adventuring physician who heals her patients with kisses.
french: Elsie m'a prêté un livre traitant de médecine selon elle, mais c'est en réalité l'histoire d'une docteure doublée d'une aventurière qui soigne ses patients en les embrassant.
russian: Элси дала мне книгу, сказала, что она о медицине, но там про странствующего врача, что лечит пациентов поцелуями.
bulgarian: Elsie loaned me a book she said was about medicine, but it's more about an adventuring physician who heals her patients with kisses.

english: It's almost like she's holding court, when she's up there.
french: Quand elle est là-bas, on dirait presque qu'elle tient salon.
russian: Когда она там сидит, у нее будто официальный приём.
bulgarian: It's almost like she's holding court, when she's up there.

english: Elsie really seems to like that gazebo, doesn't she?
french: Elsie aime beaucoup ce kiosque, non ?
russian: Элси и правда любит ту беседку, да?
bulgarian: Elsie really seems to like that gazebo, doesn't she?

english: I recently saw Elsie for a checkup, but it turned into an interrogation about aphrodisiacs. Well, I can't say she doesn't know her stuff.
french: Elsie est venue pour une simple consultation, mais la conversation a vite dérivé sur les aphrodisiaques. Je dois admettre qu'elle maîtrise le sujet.
russian: Недавно Элси приходила на осмотр, но всё закончилось расспросами про афродизиаки. Что ж, не скажу, что она ничего в этом не понимает.
bulgarian: I recently saw Elsie for a checkup, but it turned into an interrogation about aphrodisiacs. Well, I can't say she doesn't know her stuff.

english: It's a good thing, but it can be a little lonely. Sometimes the doctor's life is a real paradox, [Ari].
french: Je m'en réjouis bien entendu, mais je me sens un peu seule. La vie d'un médecin est parfois faite de paradoxes, [Ari].
russian: Это хорошо, но иногда немного одиноко. Порой жизнь врача — настоящий парадокс, [Ari].
bulgarian: It's a good thing, but it can be a little lonely. Sometimes the doctor's life is a real paradox, [Ari].

english: An empty office means healthy patients.
french: Un cabinet vide est signe de patients en bonne santé.
russian: Если кабинет пуст — значит, все здоровы.
bulgarian: An empty office means healthy patients.

english: A bit of wine at the end of the day is quite nice.
french: J'aime déguster un verre de vin en fin de journée.
russian: Немного вина в конце дня — это очень приятно.
bulgarian: A bit of wine at the end of the day is quite nice.

english: We're very lucky to have three exceptional musicians right here in Mistria.
french: Nous avons beaucoup de chance d'avoir trois musiciens exceptionnels, ici à Mistria.
russian: Нам повезло иметь трёх замечательных музыкантов прямо здесь, в Мистрии.
bulgarian: We're very lucky to have three exceptional musicians right here in Mistria.

english: It's a crisp fall evening. Now, how to spend it...
french: Quelle agréable soirée d'automne ! Que faire pour en profiter au maximum...?
russian: Свежий осенний вечер. Как бы его провести...
bulgarian: It's a crisp fall evening. Now, how to spend it...

english: Autumn is my favorite season for working outside. Something about the brisk air suits me.
french: L'automne est ma saison préférée pour travailler en extérieur. L'air frais me convient très bien.
russian: Осень — моё любимое время для работы на улице. В этом прохладном воздухе есть что-то особенное.
bulgarian: Autumn is my favorite season for working outside. Something about the brisk air suits me.

english: I wait all year for the leaves to turn... it would be a shame to work inside after they've changed color.
french: J'attends toute l'année pour voir les feuilles changer de couleur... Ce serait dommage de rater ce spectacle en restant à l'intérieur.
russian: Весь год жду, когда листья поменяют цвет... было бы жалко сидеть взаперти, когда это происходит.
bulgarian: I wait all year for the leaves to turn... it would be a shame to work inside after they've changed color.

english: Maple insisted I start one for her fluffy friend. It's a little unorthodox, but I'm just happy to see her take an interest.
french: Maple a tenu à ce que j'en crée un pour sa peluche. Ce n'est pas très orthodoxe, mais au moins, elle prend la santé au sérieux.
russian: Мэйпл настояла, чтобы я завела её для её пушистого друга. Немного необычно, но я рада, что она интересуется.
bulgarian: Maple insisted I start one for her fluffy friend. It's a little unorthodox, but I'm just happy to see her take an interest.

english: Oh, I was just looking over Prince Rabbit's medical file.
french: Oh, je consultais le dossier médical de prince Lapinou.
russian: О, я как раз просматривала медицинскую карту Принца Кролика.
bulgarian: Oh, I was just looking over Prince Rabbit's medical file.

english: I've got plenty of syrups in, for all occasions. Take a look.
french: J'ai des sirops pour tous les maux. Regarde un peu.
russian: У меня много сиропов: на все случаи жизни. Посмотри.
bulgarian: I've got plenty of syrups in, for all occasions. Take a look.

english: A cozy fall day is just the time to enjoy a good book, wouldn't you agree?
french: Une paisible journée d'automne est l'occasion rêvée de lire un bon bouquin, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Уютный осенний день — самое время насладиться хорошей книгой, правда?
bulgarian: A cozy fall day is just the time to enjoy a good book, wouldn't you agree?

english: The General Store had everything I needed... shouldn't take too long to get my rainy day soup going.
french: Il y avait tout ce dont j'avais besoin au magasin général... Je vais préparer ma soupe des jours pluvieux en deux coups de cuillère à pot.
russian: В универмаге было всё, что мне нужно... теперь можно скорее заняться супом дождливого дня.
bulgarian: The General Store had everything I needed... shouldn't take too long to get my rainy day soup going.

english: [Ari], isn't it?
french: [Ari], c'est ça ?
russian: [Ari], верно?
bulgarian: [Ari], isn't it?

english: It's nice to meet you, Valen.
french: C'est un plaisir, Valen.
russian: Приятно познакомиться, Вален.
bulgarian: It's nice to meet you, Valen.

english: Sure thing doc.
french: Bien, docteure.
russian: Конечно, док.
bulgarian: Sure thing doc.

english: Me? I'm the town's doctor. I run our $Clinic$. No need for formalities though, you can just call me Valen.
french: Moi, je suis la docteure de la ville. Je dirige la $clinique$ locale. Pas de chichi entre nous. Appelle-moi Valen.
russian: Я? Я местная докторша. Руковожу нашей $клиникой$. Но не нужно формальностей — просто зови меня Вален.
bulgarian: Me? I'm the town's doctor. I run our $Clinic$. No need for formalities though, you can just call me Valen.

english: It's nice to meet you, Valen.
french: C'est un plaisir de te rencontrer, Valen.
russian: Очень приятно, Вален.
bulgarian: It's nice to meet you, Valen.

english: Sure thing doc.
french: Ça marche, doc.
russian: Так точно, док.
bulgarian: Sure thing doc.

english: You too, [Ari]. I hope you're getting settled in alright.
french: Idem, [Ari]. J'espère que ton installation se passe bien.
russian: Взаимно, [Ari]. Надеюсь, обживаешься без проблем.
bulgarian: You too, [Ari]. I hope you're getting settled in alright.

english: Really, Valen is fine.
french: Valen, c'est suffisant.
russian: Лучше Вален, правда.
bulgarian: Really, Valen is fine.

english: Running a farm is hard work.
french: C'est beaucoup de travail de s'occuper d'une ferme.
russian: Ухаживать за фермой — дело непростое.
bulgarian: Running a farm is hard work.

english: Be sure that you get $plenty of sleep$ and $eat well$ to keep your energy up.
french: Veille à $dormir suffisamment$ et à $bien manger$ pour rester en pleine forme.
russian: Обязательно $высыпайся$ и $питайся$ как следует, чтобы не терять силы.
bulgarian: Be sure that you get $plenty of sleep$ and $eat well$ to keep your energy up.

english: Hello, you must be the new farmer.
french: Oh, bonjour ! C'est certainement toi qui as repris la ferme.
russian:
Здравствуйте. Ты, должно быть,

новые фермер

новая фермеркановый фермерновое фермер.
bulgarian: Hello, you must be the new farmer.

english: Hayden had an injury-free week... I suppose he just came by to talk. That's nice.
french: Hayden ne s'est pas blessé une seule fois cette semaine... Il est juste passé discuter. Ça me change.
russian: У Хейдена прошла неделя без травм... похоже, он просто заглянул поговорить. Это приятно.
bulgarian: Hayden had an injury-free week... I suppose he just came by to talk. That's nice.

english: I doubt he'd admit it, but I get the feeling he doesn't like being alone on the farm for long stretches...
french: Il ne l'admettrait sans doute pas, mais j'ai l'impression qu'il n'aime pas rester seul à la ferme trop longtemps...
russian: Вряд ли он признается, но мне кажется, ему не по душе подолгу оставаться на ферме в одиночестве...
bulgarian: I doubt he'd admit it, but I get the feeling he doesn't like being alone on the farm for long stretches...

english: Now that you're neighbors, make some time to visit him now and then, won't you?
french: Maintenant que vous êtes voisins, rends-lui visite de temps à autre, tu veux bien ?
russian: Раз уж вы теперь соседи, найди время навещать его периодически, хорошо?
bulgarian: Now that you're neighbors, make some time to visit him now and then, won't you?

english: I'm sure it'd be good for the both of you.
french: Je suis certaine que cela vous fera du bien à tous les deux.
russian: Уверен, это пойдёт на пользу вам обоим.
bulgarian: I'm sure it'd be good for the both of you.

english: Hayden likes to have friends over for dinner often.
french: Hayden aime avoir souvent des amis à dîner.
russian: Хейден любит часто приглашать друзей на ужин.
bulgarian: Hayden likes to have friends over for dinner often.

english: Hayden said he might stop by for a visit, so I put the ointment and gauze out. I wonder which farming implement he stabbed himself with this week...
french: Hayden m'a dit qu'il passerait peut-être pour une visite, alors j'ai préparé la pommade et les bandages. Avec quel outil de jardinage s'est-il blessé, cette fois...?
russian: Хейден сказал, что может заглянуть, так что я приготовила мазь и бинты. Интересно, чем из сельхозинвентаря он на этот раз себя поранил...
bulgarian: Hayden said he might stop by for a visit, so I put the ointment and gauze out. I wonder which farming implement he stabbed himself with this week...

english: Try not to overdo it.
french: Attention au surmenage.
russian: Постарайся не переусердствовать.
bulgarian: Try not to overdo it.

english: Running around as usual I see.
french: Je vois que tu n'arrêtes pas, comme d'habitude.
russian: Как всегда, бегаешь туда-сюда, как я погляжу.
bulgarian: Running around as usual I see.

english: It's nice that you take the time to chat, even when you're not in medical need.
french: C'est gentil à toi de passer, même quand tu n'as rien.
russian: Приятно, что ты находишь время для разговора, даже когда не нужна медицинская помощь.
bulgarian: It's nice that you take the time to chat, even when you're not in medical need.

english: As a lifelong resident of Mistria, let me know if you need any pointers.
french: Je vis à Mistria depuis toujours, alors si tu as besoin de conseils, je suis là.
russian: Как жительница Мистрии с рождения я могу дать советы, если нужно.
bulgarian: As a lifelong resident of Mistria, let me know if you need any pointers.

english: I don't know if I care for Juniper's "potions", but I can't disagree that a hot bath is good for you. Don't hesitate to indulge, [Ari].
french: Je ne peux pas dire que j'approuve les « remèdes » de Juniper, mais je dois admettre qu'un bon bain fait le plus grand bien. Prends du temps pour toi, [Ari].
russian: Не знаю, что думать о «зельях» Джунипер, но не могу отрицать, что горячая ванна полезна. Не стесняйся побаловать себя, [Ari].
bulgarian: I don't know if I care for Juniper's "potions", but I can't disagree that a hot bath is good for you. Don't hesitate to indulge, [Ari].

english: Oh, you're just saying hello. That's kind of you. Um... hello.
french: Oh, tu passes juste dire bonjour. C'est gentil. Hum... bonjour.
russian:
О, просто

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло поздороваться. Это мило. Эм... здравствуй.
bulgarian: Oh, you're just saying hello. That's kind of you. Um... hello.

english: Are you hurt, [Ari]?
french: Quelque chose ne va pas, [Ari] ?
russian: Что-то болит, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Are you hurt, [Ari]?

english: If you spend a lot of time in the sun, be sure to stay hydrated.
french: Si tu passes beaucoup de temps au soleil, n'oublie pas de bien t'hydrater.
russian: Если много времени проводишь на солнце, не забывай пить воду.
bulgarian: If you spend a lot of time in the sun, be sure to stay hydrated.

english: The cooking at the Inn is excellent and their wine cellar is expansive, if you haven't indulged yet, [Ari].
french: La nourriture qu'ils servent à l'auberge est excellente et leur cave est bien fournie. N'hésite pas à goûter à leurs crus, [Ari].
russian:
Кухня в трактире отличная и в винном погребе у них обширный выбор, если ещё не

пробовали

пробовалапробовалпробовало, [Ari].
bulgarian: The cooking at the Inn is excellent and their wine cellar is expansive, if you haven't indulged yet, [Ari].

english: This mulled wine is just what I needed today.
french: Un bon vin chaud, c'est ce dont j'avais besoin aujourd'hui.
russian: Глинтвейн — как раз то, что мне нужно сегодня.
bulgarian: This mulled wine is just what I needed today.

english: I'm quite fond of it.
french: J'aime cette ambiance.
russian: Мне тут очень нравится.
bulgarian: I'm quite fond of it.

english: There's something comforting about this old building, isn't there?
french: Cette vieille bâtisse a quelque chose de réconfortant, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Есть в этом старом здании что-то успокаивающее.
bulgarian: There's something comforting about this old building, isn't there?

english: It's working so far.
french: Et pour l'instant, ça fonctionne.
russian: Пока что работает отлично.
bulgarian: It's working so far.

english: Bit of a long day today, so I thought I'd come by the Inn to relax.
french: La journée a été assez difficile, alors j'ai eu envie de passer à l'auberge pour me détendre.
russian: У меня сегодня был долгий день, так что я решила прийти развеяться в трактир.
bulgarian: Bit of a long day today, so I thought I'd come by the Inn to relax.

english: Every day I expect Juniper to limp in here with a twisted ankle from those ridiculous boots of hers.
french: Il ne se passe pas un jour sans que je m'imagine Juniper débarquer avec une cheville foulée à cause de ses bottes aux talons ridiculement hauts.
russian: Каждый день жду, что Джунипер ввалится сюда с вывихнутой лодыжкой из-за этих нелепых сапог.
bulgarian: Every day I expect Juniper to limp in here with a twisted ankle from those ridiculous boots of hers.

english: Juniper's out for the morning, which makes it the perfect time for a peaceful visit to the Bathhouse. She always hovers when I'm here...
french: Juniper s'absente le matin, c'est donc le moment idéal pour profiter des bains en toute tranquillité. Elle vient toujours me voir quand j'y suis...
russian: Джунипер по утрам не бывает, так что это лучшее время для спокойного визита в купальню. Она всегда кружит вокруг, когда я там...
bulgarian: Juniper's out for the morning, which makes it the perfect time for a peaceful visit to the Bathhouse. She always hovers when I'm here...

english: You're keeping busy, aren't you? That's good.
french: Tu as toujours quelque chose à faire, hein ? C'est bien.
russian: Дела идут, да? Это хорошо.
bulgarian: You're keeping busy, aren't you? That's good.

english: [Ari], you look well! I hope you're keeping warm.
french: [Ari], tu as l'air en forme ! J'espère que tu penses à bien te couvrir.
russian: [Ari], ты выглядишь здорово! Надеюсь, не мёрзнешь.
bulgarian: [Ari], you look well! I hope you're keeping warm.

english: Landen and my father grew up together, back when the town was more populous. Landen and Errol were always getting into trouble and my father was always patching them up.
french: Landen et mon père ont grandi ensemble. À l'époque, il y avait plus d'habitants. Landen et Errol n'arrêtaient pas de se chamailler et mon père devait toujours les réconcilier.
russian: Ланден и мой отец росли вместе, когда город был более людным. Ланден и Эррол всегда попадали в неприятности, а мой отец их латал.
bulgarian: Landen and my father grew up together, back when the town was more populous. Landen and Errol were always getting into trouble and my father was always patching them up.

english: I like to keep my office clean. Nothing's more unsightly than a dusty skeleton. I'm running a clinic, not a haunted house.
french: J'aime que mon cabinet soit impeccable. Il n'y a rien de plus désagréable qu'un squelette poussiéreux. Je tiens une clinique, pas une maison hantée.
russian: Мне нравится держать кабинет в чистоте. Нет ничего хуже пыльного скелета. У меня ведь клиника, а не дом с привидениями.
bulgarian: I like to keep my office clean. Nothing's more unsightly than a dusty skeleton. I'm running a clinic, not a haunted house.

english: Celine loaned me a very interesting book about medicinal herbs. I wonder if Nora can procure these oils and extracts for me.
french: Céline m'a prêté un livre très intéressant sur les herbes médicinales. Je me demande si Nora pourrait se procurer ces huiles et ces baumes pour moi.
russian: Селин одолжила мне очень интересную книгу о лечебных травах. Интересно, сможет ли Нора достать эти масла и экстракты.
bulgarian: Celine loaned me a very interesting book about medicinal herbs. I wonder if Nora can procure these oils and extracts for me.

english: Good for her! My father would be happy to see it.
french: Elle a vraiment la main verte ! Mon père serait heureux de voir ça.
russian: Молодец! Мой отец был бы рад это видеть.
bulgarian: Good for her! My father would be happy to see it.

english: The roses were here during my father's time, too, but Celine has really brought the manor garden back to its former glory.
french: Ces roses étaient déjà là du temps de mon père, mais Céline a rendu au jardin du manoir sa gloire d'antan.
russian: Эти розы росли ещё во времена моего отца, но Селин действительно вернула сад особняка к прежней красоте.
bulgarian: The roses were here during my father's time, too, but Celine has really brought the manor garden back to its former glory.

english: The manor garden is looking nice, even in the winter. I wonder how Celine does it.
french: Le jardin du manoir est toujours impeccable, même en hiver. Je me demande comment s'y prend Céline.
russian: Сад у особняка такой ухоженный, даже зимой. Интересно, как Селин с ним справляется.
bulgarian: The manor garden is looking nice, even in the winter. I wonder how Celine does it.

english: Unless Juniper is at the till. Then I come back later.
french: Sauf si Juniper est à l'accueil. Dans ce cas, je reviens plus tard.
russian: Если только Джунипер не на кассе. Тогда я прихожу позже.
bulgarian: Unless Juniper is at the till. Then I come back later.

english: This isn't medical advice per se, but I find that a bath in the morning sets a good tone for my day.
french: Ce n'est pas vraiment un conseil médical, mais je trouve qu'un bain matinal me donne de l'entrain pour la journée.
russian: Это не врачебная рекомендация, но я считаю, что утренняя ванна задаёт правильный тон моему дню.
bulgarian: This isn't medical advice per se, but I find that a bath in the morning sets a good tone for my day.

english: There's a particular blend of immunity-boosting tea I like to drink on rainy days... not that rainy days cause colds! I just like the taste.
french: Quand il pleut, j'aime boire un thé particulier qui renforce l'immunité... Ça ne veut pas dire que la pluie provoque des rhumes ! C'est juste qu'il a bon goût.
russian: Есть один особый чай для укрепления иммунитета, который я люблю пить дождливыми днями... не то чтобы дождь вызывал простуду! Просто вкус хороший.
bulgarian: There's a particular blend of immunity-boosting tea I like to drink on rainy days... not that rainy days cause colds! I just like the taste.

english: I prefer less hustle and bustle, to be honest.
french: Désormais, je fuis l'agitation.
russian: Честно говоря, мне нравится, что меньше суеты.
bulgarian: I prefer less hustle and bustle, to be honest.

english: Mornings were so much noisier in the Capital.
french: Dans la capitale, les matinées étaient bien plus bruyantes.
russian: Утро в столице всегда было намного шумнее.
bulgarian: Mornings were so much noisier in the Capital.

english: I do love a nice mulled wine.
french: J'apprécie un bon petit vin chaud.
russian: Обожаю глинтвейн.
bulgarian: I do love a nice mulled wine.

english: Speaking as a doctor, knowledge of the past helps me address problems of the present.
french: En tant que docteure, j'estime que le savoir du passé nous aide à résoudre les problèmes du présent.
russian: Говорю как докторша: знание прошлого помогает лечить проблемы настоящего.
bulgarian: Speaking as a doctor, knowledge of the past helps me address problems of the present.

english: It's good that Eiland and Errol are creating a record of things.
french: Eiland et Errol font du bon travail en répertoriant toutes sortes de choses.
russian: Хорошо, что Эйланд и Эррол составляют записи.
bulgarian: It's good that Eiland and Errol are creating a record of things.

english: It's always nice and quiet here. It's easy to be contemplative, hand-in-hand with nature and the past.
french: J'aime le calme de ce lieu. Ces spécimens trouvés dans la nature et ces objets du passé invitent à la contemplation.
russian: Здесь всегда тихо и спокойно. Легко задуматься, гуляя рука об руку с природой и прошлым.
bulgarian: It's always nice and quiet here. It's easy to be contemplative, hand-in-hand with nature and the past.

english: Impressive.
french: C'est impressionnant.
russian: Впечатляет.
bulgarian: Impressive.

english: The Museum's collection has grown since the last time I was here.
french: La collection du musée s'est étoffée depuis ma dernière visite.
russian: С моего последнего посещения музея коллекция существенно пополнилась.
bulgarian: The Museum's collection has grown since the last time I was here.

english: I suspect I have you to thank for it.
french: Mon petit doigt me dit que tu n'y es pas pour rien.
russian: Думаю, за это мне стоит поблагодарить тебя.
bulgarian: I suspect I have you to thank for it.

english: Oh, hello [Ari]. Are you also doing grocery shopping? The produce is looking especially fresh today.
french: Tiens, bonjour [Ari]. Tu fais quelques courses ? Les produits ont l'air particulièrement frais aujourd'hui.
russian: О, привет, [Ari]. Ты тоже за продуктами? Овощи сегодня особенно свежие.
bulgarian: Oh, hello [Ari]. Are you also doing grocery shopping? The produce is looking especially fresh today.

english: It's uncanny how healthy Olric is. I've seen that man do his workout in the rain and snow and walk away with nary a sniffle. Terrible hayfever, though.
french: Olric mène une vie incroyablement saine. J'ai vu ce garçon s'entraîner sous la pluie et sous la neige, mais il ne prend jamais froid. En revanche, il a des rhumes des foins terribles.
russian: У Ольрика просто жутко крепкое здоровье.. Видела, как он тренировался под дождём и снегом и отделался лёгким насморком. Только сенная лихорадка мучает.
bulgarian: It's uncanny how healthy Olric is. I've seen that man do his workout in the rain and snow and walk away with nary a sniffle. Terrible hayfever, though.

english: I'm still trying to figure antidotes for these last two. You don't suppose Juniper knows, do you? She seems like she would.
french: J'essaie de découvrir un antidote pour ces deux-là. Tu crois que Juniper saurait quelque chose ? Ce serait bien le genre.
russian: Всё ещё ищу противоядие для последних двух. Как думаешь, Джунипер знает? Думаю, это возможно.
bulgarian: I'm still trying to figure antidotes for these last two. You don't suppose Juniper knows, do you? She seems like she would.

english: It's rare that I get the chance to work out of doors, but I got lucky this week. I've been finishing up this survey of poisons.
french: Je sors rarement pour le travail, mais ça m'est arrivé cette semaine. Je termine une étude sur les poisons.
russian: Редко получается работать на улице, но на этой неделе повезло. Заканчиваю исследование ядов.
bulgarian: It's rare that I get the chance to work out of doors, but I got lucky this week. I've been finishing up this survey of poisons.

english: Eiland found a record of an old plague, but after reviewing a few primary sources, I'm inclined to believe that it was just a bad case of food poisoning.
french: Eiland est tombé sur un document décrivant une ancienne épidémie. Après avoir étudié les premiers éléments, je pencherais plutôt pour une grosse intoxication alimentaire.
russian: Эйланд нашёл запись о старой чуме, но после изучения источников я склонна считать, что это было просто пищевое отравление.
bulgarian: Eiland found a record of an old plague, but after reviewing a few primary sources, I'm inclined to believe that it was just a bad case of food poisoning.

english: Adeline lent me a book from the manor. It outlines an outdated method of casting, but this formula for plaster is new to me.
french: Adeline m'a prêté un traité venant de la bibliothèque du manoir. On y décrit une ancienne méthode pour faire un plâtre, mais la composition de ce dernier m'est inconnue.
russian: Аделина одолжила мне книгу из особняка. Там устаревший метод литья, но вот формула для гипса — новая для меня.
bulgarian: Adeline lent me a book from the manor. It outlines an outdated method of casting, but this formula for plaster is new to me.

english: I hope you're getting proper sleep, [Ari]. It's the foundation of a good day.
french: J'espère que tu dors bien, [Ari]. C'est indispensable pour passer une bonne journée.
russian: Надеюсь, ты высыпаешься, [Ari]. Сон — основа хорошего дня.
bulgarian: I hope you're getting proper sleep, [Ari]. It's the foundation of a good day.

english: Be sure to have protein with your breakfast, [Ari]. You have a very active lifestyle.
french: [Ari], n'oublie pas les protéines au petit-déjeuner. Il t'en faut pour la vie que tu mènes.
russian: Обязательно ешь белок за завтраком, [Ari]. У тебя очень активный образ жизни.
bulgarian: Be sure to have protein with your breakfast, [Ari]. You have a very active lifestyle.

english: Hm, did it just get faster?
french: Mmm, c'est moi ou ton rythme cardiaque vient de s'accélérer ?
russian: Хм, почему он только что ускорился?
bulgarian: Hm, did it just get faster?

english: Give me your wrist, [Ari]. You have a strong pulse, that's good.
french: Donne ton poignet, [Ari]... Ton pouls est puissant, c'est bien.
russian: Дай-ка руку, [Ari]. Пульс в норме, это хорошо.
bulgarian: Give me your wrist, [Ari]. You have a strong pulse, that's good.

english: Oh, it's quite strong. Very good.
french: Oh, il est puissant, c'est parfait.
russian: О, он довольно стройный. Очень хорошо.
bulgarian: Oh, it's quite strong. Very good.

english: Come here so I can check your pulse.
french: Approche-toi que je prenne ton pouls.
russian: Подойди-ка, проверю твой пульс.
bulgarian: Come here so I can check your pulse.

english: Rain is nice for the folks in town with allergies. It washes all that pollen away.
french: La pluie est une bénédiction pour les habitants qui souffrent d'allergies. Elle emporte avec elle tout le pollen.
russian: Дождь полезен для тех, у кого аллергия. Он смывает всю пыльцу.
bulgarian: Rain is nice for the folks in town with allergies. It washes all that pollen away.

english: They're some of my favorite things to put in a hot drink on a rainy day.
french: J'adore en mettre dans mes infusions lorsqu'il pleut.
russian: Это мои любимые ингредиенты для горячего напитка в дождливый день.
bulgarian: They're some of my favorite things to put in a hot drink on a rainy day.

english: When the weather is dreary, I like to stock up on ginger and =Honey=.
french: Quand le temps devient maussade, je fais des provisions de gingembre et de =miel=.
russian: Когда погода пасмурная, люблю запасаться имбирём и =мёдом=.
bulgarian: When the weather is dreary, I like to stock up on ginger and =Honey=.

english: I'm reading about the rise of Caldosian medical techniques. It's... interesting.
french: Je suis en train de lire un ouvrage sur l'évolution des techniques médicales caldosiennes. C'est... intéressant.
russian: Читаю о развитии кальдосийских медицинских техник. Это... интересно.
bulgarian: I'm reading about the rise of Caldosian medical techniques. It's... interesting.

english: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Tu viens pour une consultation ?
russian: Привет, [Ari]. На осмотр?
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?

english: I'm teasing!
french: Je te taquine !
russian: Да я шучу!
bulgarian: I'm teasing!

english: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Tu viens pour une consultation ?
russian: Привет, [Ari]. Ты на обследование?
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]. Here for a check-up?

english: Welcome to the Clinic, [Ari]. Now, let's have a look at you.
french: Bienvenue à la clinique, [Ari]. Laisse-moi t'ausculter.
russian: Добро пожаловать в клинику, [Ari]. Ну что ж, осмотрим тебя.
bulgarian: Welcome to the Clinic, [Ari]. Now, let's have a look at you.

english: Let me know if you're feeling unwell, [Ari]. I'm here to help.
french: Si jamais tu ne te sens pas bien, préviens-moi, [Ari]. Je suis là pour ça.
russian: Скажи, если почувствуешь себя плохо, [Ari]. Моя задача помогать с этим.
bulgarian: Let me know if you're feeling unwell, [Ari]. I'm here to help.

english: Oh, did you need syrups for your medicine cabinet? Have a look.
french: Oh, tu as besoin de sirops pour chez toi ? Regarde ce que j'ai.
russian: О, нужны сиропы для домашней аптечки? Посмотри.
bulgarian: Oh, did you need syrups for your medicine cabinet? Have a look.

english: Is your medicine cabinet looking empty? I've got plenty of syrups to stock it with.
french: Ton armoire à pharmacie est vide ? Si c'est le cas, j'ai de nombreux sirops à te proposer.
russian: В аптечке пусто? У меня много сиропов про запас.
bulgarian: Is your medicine cabinet looking empty? I've got plenty of syrups to stock it with.

english: [Ari]! Nice to see you. I was just restocking my cabinet of syrups... there are plenty, should you need them.
french: Je suis contente de te voir, [Ari] ! J'étais en train de refaire mes provisions de sirops... Si jamais tu en as besoin, ça n'est pas ce qui manque.
russian: [Ari]! Рада видеть тебя. Как раз пополняю свой шкафчик с сиропами... бери, если что-то нужно.
bulgarian: [Ari]! Nice to see you. I was just restocking my cabinet of syrups... there are plenty, should you need them.

english: Hello, [Ari]. Let me know if I can assist.
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Dis-moi si je peux t'aider.
russian: Привет, [Ari]. Дай знать, если нужна помощь.
bulgarian: Hello, [Ari]. Let me know if I can assist.

english: Oh! I didn't see you there. Don't mind me, just reviewing some notes.
french: Oh, pardon ! Je ne t'avais pas vu<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they>. Excuse-moi, je relisais quelques notes.
russian: О! Не заметила тебя. Не обращай внимания, просто просматривала заметки.
bulgarian: Oh! I didn't see you there. Don't mind me, just reviewing some notes.

english: The serratus anterior and posterior connect to the shoulder and ribcage...
french: Le muscle dentelé postérieur et supérieur relie les épaules à la cage thoracique...
russian: Передняя и задняя зубчатые мышцы соединяют плечо и рёбра...
bulgarian: The serratus anterior and posterior connect to the shoulder and ribcage...

english: Rest brings longevity, and longevity means we'll be chatting like this for years to come.
french: Le repos permet de vivre longtemps, et une longue vie me permettra de discuter avec toi pendant encore des années.
russian: Отдых продлевает жизнь, чтобы мы еще долго могли вот так просто болтать.
bulgarian: Rest brings longevity, and longevity means we'll be chatting like this for years to come.

english: As far as sleep goes, I always get my hours in.
french: Je m'arrange toujours pour dormir suffisamment.
russian: Если говорить о сне, у меня он всегда полноценный.
bulgarian: As far as sleep goes, I always get my hours in.

english: The Saturday Market takes me back there.
french: Le marché du samedi me rappelle cette époque.
russian: Субботний базар здесь напоминает мне об этом.
bulgarian: The Saturday Market takes me back there.

english: In the Capital, I would find a nook on Main Street and read a book while people did their weekend shopping.
french: Quand j'étais à la capitale, j'arrivais souvent à me trouver un petit coin un peu en retrait de la rue principale. Je m'installais pour lire un livre pendant que tout le monde faisait son shopping.
russian: По выходным в столице я любила сидеть в уголке на Главной улице и читать, пока люди занимались покупками.
bulgarian: In the Capital, I would find a nook on Main Street and read a book while people did their weekend shopping.

english: The Saturday Market is great for the town's health. It gets everyone up and moving!
french: Le marché du samedi est très bon pour la santé des habitants de la ville. Ça force tout le monde à s'activer !
russian: Субботний базар полезен для здоровья города. Заставляет всех встать и размяться!
bulgarian: The Saturday Market is great for the town's health. It gets everyone up and moving!

english: Some of these crops come from your farm, don't they [Ari]? You've had a lovely harvest this year.
french: Certains de ces produits viennent de ta ferme, n'est-ce pas [Ari] ? La récolte a été bonne, cette année.
russian: Некоторые из этих овощей с твоей фермы, правда, [Ari]? У тебя отличный урожай в этом году.
bulgarian: Some of these crops come from your farm, don't they [Ari]? You've had a lovely harvest this year.

english: I like to annotate my mysteries with theories about the culprit's identity. I hope the ending isn't spoiled for her...
french: Mais j'aime bien noter mes idées sur l'identité du coupable, dans mes livres. J'espère que ça ne lui gâchera pas la fin...
russian: Я люблю писать на полях свои теории о том, кто может быть преступником. Надеюсь, это не раскроет ей концовку...
bulgarian: I like to annotate my mysteries with theories about the culprit's identity. I hope the ending isn't spoiled for her...

english: Celine was asking after reading recommendations, so I loaned her one of my favorite mystery novels.
french: Céline m'a demandé des conseils de lecture, alors je lui ai prêté un de mes romans policiers préférés.
russian: Селин приходила ко мне спросить совета что почитать. Я одолжила ей один из своих любимых детективов.
bulgarian: Celine was asking after reading recommendations, so I loaned her one of my favorite mystery novels.

english: I waited a little too long to get groceries this time... unfortunately, syrups don't make a meal.
french: Ce coup-ci, j'ai trop attendu pour faire mes courses... Malheureusement, un sirop pour la toux ne remplace pas un bon repas.
russian: Я долго откладывала поход за продуктами... А из сиропов, увы, обед не сваришь.
bulgarian: I waited a little too long to get groceries this time... unfortunately, syrups don't make a meal.

english: Landen's great-grandfather hand carved him, if you can believe it.
french: Aussi incroyable que ça puisse paraître, c'est l'arrière-grand-père de Landen qui l'a sculpté de ses mains.
russian: Прадед Ландена вырезал его вручную, представляешь?
bulgarian: Landen's great-grandfather hand carved him, if you can believe it.

english: That skeleton has been in the family a long time.
french: Ce squelette est dans ma famille depuis des lustres.
russian: Этот скелет давно в семье.
bulgarian: That skeleton has been in the family a long time.

english: And here I thought it was just me and the skeleton tonight. Evening, [Ari].
french: Tiens, moi qui pensais passer la soirée seule avec mon squelette. Bonsoir, [Ari].
russian: А я думала, что буду сегодня одна с этим скелетом. Добрый вечер, [Ari].
bulgarian: And here I thought it was just me and the skeleton tonight. Evening, [Ari].

english: Slow day today. I can't complain, it means everyone in town is healthy.
french: La journée a été calme. Je ne vais pas me plaindre, cela signifie que tout le monde en ville se porte bien.
russian: Сегодня тихо. Не жалуюсь: значит, все в городе здоровы.
bulgarian: Slow day today. I can't complain, it means everyone in town is healthy.

english: Slow down and have a drink, [Ari]. Mistria's not going anywhere.
french: Prends un moment et viens boire un verre, [Ari]. Mistria ne va pas s'écrouler si tu te poses un instant.
russian: Притормози и выпей, [Ari]. Мистрия никуда не денется.
bulgarian: Slow down and have a drink, [Ari]. Mistria's not going anywhere.

english: Stop by the Clinic if you get the sniffles.
french: Si jamais tu commences à avoir la goutte au nez, passe me voir à la clinique.
russian: Загляни в клинику, если схватит насморк.
bulgarian: Stop by the Clinic if you get the sniffles.

english: Spring is a time of renewal. And allergies.
french: Le printemps est synonyme de renaissance. Et d'allergies.
russian: Весна — время обновления. И аллергии.
bulgarian: Spring is a time of renewal. And allergies.

english: There's usually at least one poor soul who gets caught in the rain, so I like to be prepared at the Clinic.
french: Il y a toujours un ou deux pauvres hères qui se font surprendre par la pluie, donc je me tiens toujours prête à la clinique.
russian: Обычно кто-нибудь да попадёт под дождь, так что я всегда готова в клинике.
bulgarian: There's usually at least one poor soul who gets caught in the rain, so I like to be prepared at the Clinic.

english: Useful, don't you think?
french: Plutôt pratique, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Удобно, правда?
bulgarian: Useful, don't you think?

english: The Fairy Syrup has a subtle strawberry flavor, which seems popular. And if you should collapse the same day you drink it, you'll be revived.
french: Le sirop des fées a un léger goût de fraise que tout le monde semble apprécier. Et si jamais tu t'évanouis le jour où tu l'as bu, tu reprendras instantanément connaissance.
russian: Сироп Фей имеет лёгкий клубничный вкус. Он довольно популярен. А еще помогает встать на ноги, если ты его выпьешь и свалишься от усталости в течение того же дня.
bulgarian: The Fairy Syrup has a subtle strawberry flavor, which seems popular. And if you should collapse the same day you drink it, you'll be revived.

english: The Heal Syrup restores some of your health. And it tastes like cherry! Some find it a bit cloying, but you wouldn't want to taste it otherwise.
french: Le sirop de soins te permet de récupérer de la santé. Il a un goût de cerise ! Certains trouvent ça un peu écœurant, mais c'est le goût qui fait tout !
russian: Сироп исцеления восстанавливает здоровье. На вкус вишнёвый! Кому-то он кажется приторным, но лучше так, чем невкусный.
bulgarian: The Heal Syrup restores some of your health. And it tastes like cherry! Some find it a bit cloying, but you wouldn't want to taste it otherwise.

english: The Speedy Syrup will increase your personal velocity for two hours. And it tastes like summer oranges!
french: Le sirop de punch te permet d'augmenter ta vitesse de déplacement pendant deux heures. Et il est parfumé aux oranges d'été !
russian: Сироп скорости повысит твою скорость на два часа. И вкус у него, как у летних апельсинов!
bulgarian: The Speedy Syrup will increase your personal velocity for two hours. And it tastes like summer oranges!

english: Have you tried the Stamina syrup? It restores some of your stamina, and the peppermint flavor will put some pep in your step.
french: Tu as déjà goûté au sirop reconstituant ? Il te permet de récupérer un peu d'endurance et son goût mentholé te redonne du tonus.
russian:
Ты

пробовали

пробовалапробовалпробовало сироп выносливости? Он восстанавливает силы, а мятный вкус придаёт бодрости.
bulgarian: Have you tried the Stamina syrup? It restores some of your stamina, and the peppermint flavor will put some pep in your step.

english: Have a look at the Syrups I have in stock. They're all medicinal, and have withstood rigorous testing. My father did the case studies himself.
french: Jette donc un œil à mes sirops. Ce sont des médicaments qui ont été testés dans les règles de l'art. Mon père s'est chargé lui-même des essais cliniques.
russian: Посмотри сиропы, что у меня есть. Все они проверены и испытаны. Мой отец лично вёл исследования.
bulgarian: Have a look at the Syrups I have in stock. They're all medicinal, and have withstood rigorous testing. My father did the case studies himself.

english: I've got quite a few syrups in stock, if you're looking for something in particular.
french: J'ai un certain nombre de sirops en réserve, si jamais tu cherches quelque chose en particulier.
russian: У меня хороший запас сиропов, если ищешь что-то конкретное.
bulgarian: I've got quite a few syrups in stock, if you're looking for something in particular.

english: I have plenty of syrups in stock.
french: Au besoin, j'ai de nombreux sirops en stock.
russian: У меня в наличии много разных сиропов.
bulgarian: I have plenty of syrups in stock.

english: How is your medicine cabinet looking?
french: Ton armoire à pharmacie est bien remplie ?
russian: Как твоя домашняя аптечка?
bulgarian: How is your medicine cabinet looking?

english: And he became especially incensed when I told him my salad would be better for his blood pressure.
french: Il s'est mis en colère quand je lui ai dit que ma salade serait très bonne pour faire baisser sa tension artérielle.
russian: А когда я сказала, что мой салат поможет ему от давления, он просто взбесился.
bulgarian: And he became especially incensed when I told him my salad would be better for his blood pressure.

english: Why does he cook if he finds it so stressful?
french: Pourquoi est-ce qu'il cuisine s'il trouve ça aussi stressant ?
russian: Зачем он тогда готовит, если для него это такой стресс?
bulgarian: Why does he cook if he finds it so stressful?

english: Taliferro seemed quite unhappy with my entry for the $Cooking Challenge$.
french: Taliferro ne semblait pas satisfait de ce que j'avais préparé pour le $défi gastronomique$.
russian: Талиферро, видимо, совершенно не понравилось, что я принесла на $смотр блюд$.
bulgarian: Taliferro seemed quite unhappy with my entry for the $Cooking Challenge$.

english: The last time I ran into Terithia she said she eats =Canned Sardines= for breakfast AND lunch every day. Do you know how much salt that is!?
french: Quand j'ai croisé Terithia, elle m'a dit qu'elle mangeait tous les jours des =sardines en boîte= pour le petit-déjeuner ET pour le déjeuner. Tu te rends compte de la dose de sel ?!
russian: В прошлый раз Теризия сказала, что ест =консервированные сардины= и на завтрак и на обед. Представляешь, сколько там соли?!
bulgarian: The last time I ran into Terithia she said she eats =Canned Sardines= for breakfast AND lunch every day. Do you know how much salt that is!?

english: Good, your tonsils look fine.
french: Tout est en ordre au niveau des amygdales, très bien.
russian: Хорошо, миндалины в порядке.
bulgarian: Good, your tonsils look fine.

english: Open your mouth and stick our your tongue, [Ari].
french: Ouvre la bouche et tire la langue, [Ari].
russian: Открой рот и высунь язык, [Ari].
bulgarian: Open your mouth and stick our your tongue, [Ari].

english: I always look forward to it.
french: J'attends toujours ce jour avec impatience.
russian: Я всегда с нетерпением его жду.
bulgarian: I always look forward to it.

english: The Saturday Market really transforms the town square.
french: Le marché du samedi transforme totalement la place principale.
russian: Субботний базар действительно преображает площадь.
bulgarian: The Saturday Market really transforms the town square.

english: Nothing like a walk to get the blood pumping.
french: Rien de tel qu'une bonne petite marche pour activer la circulation sanguine.
russian: Лёгкая прогулка помогает разогнать кровь.
bulgarian: Nothing like a walk to get the blood pumping.

english: I was thinking of going to Dozy's bathhouse soon.
french: Je songeais à aller faire un petit tour aux bains de Dozy.
russian: Я планирую зайти к Дреме в купальню.
bulgarian: I was thinking of going to Dozy's bathhouse soon.

english: Let's both make the most of it.
french: Qu'elle soit fructueuse pour toi comme pour moi.
russian: Пускай у нас с тобой день пройдёт хорошо.
bulgarian: Let's both make the most of it.

english: It's good to see you enjoying the day, [Ari].
french: Je suis contente de voir que tu profites bien de la journée, [Ari].
russian:
Рада видеть, что ты

вышли

вышлавышелвышло погулять, [Ari].
bulgarian: It's good to see you enjoying the day, [Ari].

english: Oh, they got pinker!
french: Oh, tu as rougi !
russian: Ой, а теперь ещё розовее!
bulgarian: Oh, they got pinker!

english: Nice to see you with a bit of pink in your cheeks.
french: Je vois que tu as bonne mine, ça me fait plaisir.
russian: У тебя такие розовые щёки — приятно смотреть.
bulgarian: Nice to see you with a bit of pink in your cheeks.

english: Working outdoors is good for the spirits, but I better get back to the Clinic.
french: Travailler en extérieur est très bon pour le moral, mais je ferais bien de retourner à la clinique.
russian: Работа на улице полезна для духа, но пора возвращаться в клинику.
bulgarian: Working outdoors is good for the spirits, but I better get back to the Clinic.

english: Taking a walk every day is healthy, especially if you spend most of your time indoors.
french: Faire une promenade tous les jours est très bon pour la santé, surtout quand on passe beaucoup de temps enfermé.
russian: Ежедневные прогулки полезны для здоровья: особенно, если большую часть времени проводишь в помещении.
bulgarian: Taking a walk every day is healthy, especially if you spend most of your time indoors.

english: Hayden and I grew up together. Did you know that I used to be taller than him?
french: Hayden et moi, on a grandi ensemble. Tu savais que je le dépassais en taille autrefois ?
russian: Мы с Хейденом вместе росли. Знаешь, что я раньше была выше его?
bulgarian: Hayden and I grew up together. Did you know that I used to be taller than him?

english: Be sure to visit the Beach, [Ari]. The sea air is good for your lungs. And the sun is a mood booster.
french: N'oublie pas d'aller à la plage de temps en temps, [Ari]. L'air marin est bon pour les poumons, et le soleil fait des merveilles pour le moral.
russian: Не забудь сходить на пляж, [Ari]. Морской воздух полезен для лёгких, а солнце поднимает настроение.
bulgarian: Be sure to visit the Beach, [Ari]. The sea air is good for your lungs. And the sun is a mood booster.

english: Keep out of the rain if you can help it, [Ari]. Just some friendly doctor's advice.
french: Essaie de ne pas trop traîner sous la pluie, si tu peux l'éviter, [Ari]. C'est juste un petit conseil de ton amie docteure.
russian: Старайся не попадать под дождь, [Ari]. Просто дружеский совет врача.
bulgarian: Keep out of the rain if you can help it, [Ari]. Just some friendly doctor's advice.

english: I worry about Adeline. She's so busy keeping an eye on this town, someone needs to keep an eye on her. And by "someone" I mean me, her doctor.
french: Je m'inquiète pour Adeline. Elle veille à ce que tout fonctionne bien en ville, mais il faut que quelqu'un veille sur elle à son tour. Ce quelqu'un, c'est moi, son médecin.
