french: Je ne sais pas si tu te rends compte à quel point cette $amanite tue-mouches$ est vénéneuse.
russian: Я не уверена, что ты хорошо понимаешь, насколько ядовит этот $красный мухомор$.
bulgarian: I'm not sure you're aware how poisonous this $Red Toadstool$ is.

english: Oh, thank you. A bit of =Red Wine= with dinner is quite nice.
french: Oh, merci. Un petit peu de =vin rouge= accompagne toujours très bien un repas.
russian: Ой, спасибо. Немного =красного вина= не помешает к ужину.
bulgarian: Oh, thank you. A bit of =Red Wine= with dinner is quite nice.

english: Roses give way to =Rose Hips=, and both make a lovely tea.
french: Les roses finissent par donner de l'=églantine= et les deux permettent de préparer un thé exquis.
russian: В один сезон там появляются розы, а в другой — =шиповник=. И из обоих получается прекрасный чай.
bulgarian: Roses give way to =Rose Hips=, and both make a lovely tea.

english: Thank you.
french: Merci.
russian: Спасибо.
bulgarian: Thank you.

english: The rose plant has so many uses, doesn't it?
french: Le rosier a de nombreuses utilisations, hein ?
russian: Как много пользы приносят розовые кусты!
bulgarian: The rose plant has so many uses, doesn't it?

english: I know that berry jam is considered a classic, but I favor =Rose Hip Jam=.
french: Je sais que la confiture de baies est la plus populaire, mais je préfère la =confiture d'églantine=.
russian: =Варенье из шиповника= нравится мне больше других, хотя оно довольно непривычное на вкус.
bulgarian: I know that berry jam is considered a classic, but I favor =Rose Hip Jam=.

english: Oh, thank you.
french: Oh, merci.
russian: Ой, спасибо.
bulgarian: Oh, thank you.

english: Rosemary can kill germs, which makes it useful as a food preservative, as well as a spice.
french: Le romarin peut tuer les microbes, ce qui en fait un parfait conservateur pour les aliments. C'est aussi une très bonne herbe aromatique.
russian: Розмарин убивает бактерии. Поэтому его можно использовать как приправу и как консервант.
bulgarian: Rosemary can kill germs, which makes it useful as a food preservative, as well as a spice.

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: Merci [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: Oh, is that =Rosemary=? It smells wonderful.
french: Oh, c'est du =romarin= ? Il sent très bon.
russian: О, это у тебя =розмарин=? Пахнет чудесно.
bulgarian: Oh, is that =Rosemary=? It smells wonderful.

english: So I simply can't resist a plate of =Rosemary Garlic Noodles=!
french: Donc je ne peux tout simplement pas résister à une assiette de =nouilles à l'ail et au romarin= !
russian: Так что от =пасты с розмарином= я никогда не откажусь!
bulgarian: So I simply can't resist a plate of =Rosemary Garlic Noodles=!

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: Oh, this smells delicious! I'm partial to both =Rosemary= and =Garlic=...
french: Oh, quelle odeur merveilleuse ! Le =romarin= et l'=ail= sont deux de mes péchés mignons...
russian: Ой, какой аппетитный аромат! Я люблю и =розмарин= и =чеснок=...
bulgarian: Oh, this smells delicious! I'm partial to both =Rosemary= and =Garlic=...

english: It's packed with nutrients. Thank you for the gift!
french: C'est plein de vitamines. Merci pour ce cadeau !
russian: Они содержат множество питательных веществ. Спасибо, это хороший подарок.
bulgarian: It's packed with nutrients. Thank you for the gift!

english: Eating dark leafy greens are good for you, and =Seaweed= is good for you in the same way.
french: Manger des légumes à feuilles est bon pour la santé, et l'=algue= produit les mêmes effets.
russian: Тёмная листовая зелень полезна для здоровья. По той же причине полезны и =водоросли=.
bulgarian: Eating dark leafy greens are good for you, and =Seaweed= is good for you in the same way.

english: I suppose that's one of the benefits of living next to the ocean.
french: C'est l'un des avantages de vivre près de l'océan.
russian: Впрочем, в этом и плюс жить рядом с океаном.
bulgarian: I suppose that's one of the benefits of living next to the ocean.

english: Thank you.
french: Merci.
russian: Спасибо.
bulgarian: Thank you.

english: This =Seaweed Salad= looks so fresh!
french: Cette =salade d'algues= a l'air pleine de fraîcheur !
russian: Какой свежий =салат из водорослей=!
bulgarian: This =Seaweed Salad= looks so fresh!

english: You know, I used to go foraging with my father to make this recipe.
french: Tu sais, avec mon père, on allait souvent chercher les ingrédients en pleine nature pour préparer cette salade.
russian: Знаешь, раньше мы с отцом ходили собирать для него ингредиенты.
bulgarian: You know, I used to go foraging with my father to make this recipe.

english: All the ingredients grow wild around here!
french: Et ce ne sont pas les ingrédients sauvages qui manquent, dans le coin !
russian: Они все здесь растут в дикой среде!
bulgarian: All the ingredients grow wild around here!

english: Well, thank you for this lovely =Spring Salad=.
french: Merci pour cette merveilleuse =salade printanière=.
russian: Благодарю тебя за прекрасный =зелёный салат=.
bulgarian: Well, thank you for this lovely =Spring Salad=.

english: And a bit of chili pepper brings summer heat, as well. Thank you.
french: Et le piment rappelle la chaleur de l'été. Merci.
russian: А щепотка перца чили передаёт летнюю жару. Спасибо.
bulgarian: And a bit of chili pepper brings summer heat, as well. Thank you.

english: This =Summer Salad= truly makes it feel like summer! Look at those lovely, bright colors!
french: Cette =salade d'été= est vraiment parfaite pour les beaux jours ! Regarde toutes ces couleurs vives !
russian: Этот =летний салат= и правда раскрывает краски лета! Смотри, какие яркие цвета!
bulgarian: This =Summer Salad= truly makes it feel like summer! Look at those lovely, bright colors!

english: I'm going to enjoy this! Thank you.
french: Je vais me régaler ! Merci.
russian: Это мне точно понравится! Спасибо.
bulgarian: I'm going to enjoy this! Thank you.

english: What a beautiful =Sushi Platter=!
french: Quel magnifique =plateau de sushis= !
russian: Какое прекрасное =ассорти суши=!
bulgarian: What a beautiful =Sushi Platter=!

english: I've enjoyed this particular snack since I was a child.
french: Ça me sert d'encas depuis que je suis petite.
russian: Я любила его есть в качестве закуски, когда была маленькая.
bulgarian: I've enjoyed this particular snack since I was a child.

english: =Sweetroot=! Thank you, this was difficult to get while the Mines were closed.
french: Un =rhizome sucré= ! Merci, il était difficile d'en obtenir tant que la mine était fermée.
russian: =Сладкий корень=! Спасибо. Пока шахты были закрыты, добыть его было очень трудно.
bulgarian: =Sweetroot=! Thank you, this was difficult to get while the Mines were closed.

english: I've been told this variety is quite rare. Thank you, [Ari]!
french: Il paraît que c'est une variété rare. Merci [Ari] !
russian: Мне говорили, что этот вид встречается довольно редко. Спасибо, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I've been told this variety is quite rare. Thank you, [Ari]!

english: Oh, is this =Underseaweed=?
french: Oh, c'est du =varech sous-marin= ?
russian: Ого, это =подводоросли=?
bulgarian: Oh, is this =Underseaweed=?

english: A simple =Vegetable Soup= is such a comfort.
french: Une =soupe de légumes= toute simple fait toujours du bien.
russian: Даже от простого =овощного супа= я чувствую такой уют.
bulgarian: A simple =Vegetable Soup= is such a comfort.

english: It reminds me of days spent in the warmth of the Inn.
french: Cela me rappelle les journées que je passais au chaud, à l'auberge.
russian: Сразу вспоминаю те дни, когда грелась у очага в трактире.
bulgarian: It reminds me of days spent in the warmth of the Inn.

english: Oh wonderful, thank you!
french: Oh, fabuleux, merci !
russian: Ой, как славно, спасибо!
bulgarian: Oh wonderful, thank you!

english: Oh, I do like a dry =White Wine=. Thank you.
french: Oh, j'aime beaucoup le =vin blanc= sec. Je te remercie.
russian: О, я очень даже не против сухого =белого вина=. Спасибо.
bulgarian: Oh, I do like a dry =White Wine=. Thank you.

english: I generally recommend against stimulants, but the pleasure of =Coffee= is undeniable.
french: En général, je déconseille la consommation de produits stimulants, mais il faut avouer que le =café= procure un plaisir indéniable.
russian: Я обычно не советую стимуляторы, но удовольствие от =кофе= отрицать сложно.
bulgarian: I generally recommend against stimulants, but the pleasure of =Coffee= is undeniable.

english: Darcy's =Coffee= is a regular part of my schedule... hard to start the day without it.
french: Le =café= de Darcy fait partie de ma routine quotidienne... J'ai même du mal à commencer ma journée sans.
russian: =Кофе= Дарси — часть моего утреннего распорядка... день без него трудно начать.
bulgarian: Darcy's =Coffee= is a regular part of my schedule... hard to start the day without it.

english: How do I take my =Coffee=? Black as the night, [Ari]. Is there any other way?
french: Tu veux savoir comment je prends mon =café= ? Noir comme la nuit, [Ari]. Il y a une autre façon de le déguster ?
russian: Какой я пью =кофе=? Чёрный, как ночь, [Ari]. А как же иначе?
bulgarian: How do I take my =Coffee=? Black as the night, [Ari]. Is there any other way?

english: Darcy says Juniper likes her =Latte= a bit sweet. How interesting.
french: Darcy dit qu'elle aime boire son =café latte= légèrement sucré. Voilà qui est très intéressant...
russian: Дарси говорит, Джунипер любит =латте= послаще. Любопытно.
bulgarian: Darcy says Juniper likes her =Latte= a bit sweet. How interesting.

english: You can always rely on Louis for a good pair of slacks.
french: Tu peux acheter les pantalons de Louis les yeux fermés.
russian: На Луи всегда можно положиться, когда нужна хорошая пара брюк.
bulgarian: You can always rely on Louis for a good pair of slacks.

english: Every one of my coats is from Louis... he's managed to sell me one for every season.
french: Toutes mes blouses viennent de chez Louis... Il a réussi à m'en vendre une pour chaque saison.
russian: Все мои пальто — от Луи... он умудрился продать мне по одному на каждый сезон.
bulgarian: Every one of my coats is from Louis... he's managed to sell me one for every season.

english: I'm partial to a button-up, but Louis talked me into a turtleneck a few years ago. I have to admit, I liked it very much.
french: J'ai un faible pour les chemisiers, mais Louis m'a convaincue d'acheter un col roulé, il y a quelques années. Je dois admettre que je l'aime beaucoup.
russian: Я больше по классике: с пуговицами, — но Луи однажды уговорил меня на водолазку. Признаюсь, она мне понравилась.
bulgarian: I'm partial to a button-up, but Louis talked me into a turtleneck a few years ago. I have to admit, I liked it very much.

english: Louis really understands the art of a crisp lapel.
french: Louis sait très bien qu'un joli carré fait toute la différence.
russian: Луи отлично понимает, что значит идеальный отворот.
bulgarian: Louis really understands the art of a crisp lapel.

english: That big desk at the front of my clinic is from Merri's shop... Olric and Hayden were kind enough to carry it home for me.
french: Le grand bureau à l'entrée de ma clinique vient de chez Merri... Olric et Hayden ont eu la gentillesse de le transporter jusque chez moi.
russian: Тот большой стол у входа в мою клинику — из лавки Мэрри... Ольрик и Хейден любезно помогли мне донести его до дома.
bulgarian: That big desk at the front of my clinic is from Merri's shop... Olric and Hayden were kind enough to carry it home for me.

english: I tend to prefer a bit of simplicity and many of Merri's pieces are rather decorative, but I'm very fond of the fancy armchair I purchased from her...
french: Je suis plutôt adepte de ce qui est sobre et les meubles de Merri sont parfois chargés. Néanmoins, j'aime beaucoup le fauteuil que je lui ai acheté...
russian: Я предпочитаю что-то простое, а в лавке Мэрри много вычурных вещей. Но я однажды купила у нее одно изящное кресло...
bulgarian: I tend to prefer a bit of simplicity and many of Merri's pieces are rather decorative, but I'm very fond of the fancy armchair I purchased from her...

english: I fall asleep in it almost as often as my own bed.
french: Je dors dedans à peu près aussi souvent que dans mon propre lit.
russian: Я засыпаю в нём почти так же часто, как в своей кровати.
bulgarian: I fall asleep in it almost as often as my own bed.

english: Did Juniper get her throne of a chair from Merri's shop? Hm... it suits her.
french: Juniper a-t-elle acheté le trône qui lui sert de fauteuil chez Merri ? Dans tous les cas, il est parfait pour elle.
russian: Интересно, Джунипер купила свой «трон» у Мэрри? Хм... ей он подходит.
bulgarian: Did Juniper get her throne of a chair from Merri's shop? Hm... it suits her.

english: Hayden's got plenty of furniture from Merri... he and Olric help her set up her booth on the Saturdays she's at market.
french: La plupart des meubles d'Hayden viennent de chez Merri... Olric et lui l'aident à s'installer le samedi, quand elle vient au marché.
russian: У Хейдена полно мебели от Мэрри... он с Ольриком помогает ей устраивать лавку на базаре по субботам.
bulgarian: Hayden's got plenty of furniture from Merri... he and Olric help her set up her booth on the Saturdays she's at market.

english: I don't believe a word of Stillwell's fortunes, but his presentation is quite amusing.
bulgarian: I don't believe a word of Stillwell's fortunes, but his presentation is quite amusing.

english: When I first met Stillwell I thought he had a bit of a pale complexion, but he seems quite healthy. Is it makeup?
bulgarian: When I first met Stillwell I thought he had a bit of a pale complexion, but he seems quite healthy. Is it makeup?

english: Juniper insisted I get a fortune from Stillwell, but it seems like a waste of tesserae to me.
bulgarian: Juniper insisted I get a fortune from Stillwell, but it seems like a waste of tesserae to me.

english: Juniper bullied me into getting a life fortune... "You will live another day". I suppose it's not technically incorrect...
bulgarian: Juniper bullied me into getting a life fortune... "You will live another day". I suppose it's not technically incorrect...

english: The doctor in me would rather just eat the fruit...
french: La docteure que je suis n'aurait mangé que les fruits...
russian: Врач во мне говорит, что лучше было бы просто съесть фрукт...
bulgarian: The doctor in me would rather just eat the fruit...

english: Nice foam, though.
french: Mais la mousse était bonne.
russian: Но пенка была красивая.
bulgarian: Nice foam, though.

english: I ate at Taliferro's restaurant when I was in the Capital. He served me a dessert with foam infused with some exotic fruit.
french: J'ai mangé dans le restaurant de Taliferro, quand j'étais dans la capitale. Il m'avait servi une mousse aromatisée aux fruits exotiques.
russian: Я была в ресторане у Талиферро, когда жила в столице. Он подал мне десерт с пенкой из какого-то экзотического фрукта.
bulgarian: I ate at Taliferro's restaurant when I was in the Capital. He served me a dessert with foam infused with some exotic fruit.

english: I should refer him to a colleague in the Capital.
french: Je devrais l'envoyer consulter un de mes collègues, à la capitale.
russian: Надо направить его к моему столичному коллеге...
bulgarian: I should refer him to a colleague in the Capital.

english: Have you seen the way Taliferro grinds his teeth? And how the vein on his neck bulges? He seems to be under a great deal of stress.
french: Tu as remarqué la façon dont Taliferro grince des dents ? Et comment les veines de son cou enflent ? Ce garçon doit être soumis à un stress important.
russian:
Ты

видели

виделавиделвидело, как Талиферро сжимает челюсти? И как у него раздуваются вены на шее? Кажется, он очень напряжён.
bulgarian: Have you seen the way Taliferro grinds his teeth? And how the vein on his neck bulges? He seems to be under a great deal of stress.

english: He looks like any amount of stimulant might make him explode.
french: On dirait qu'une infime quantité de n'importe quel produit stimulant pourrait le faire exploser.
russian: По его виду кажется, что от любой дозы кофеина он взорвётся.
bulgarian: He looks like any amount of stimulant might make him explode.

english: Possibly literally.
french: Peut-être même littéralement.
russian: Возможно, даже буквально.
bulgarian: Possibly literally.

english: I don't recommend giving Taliferro any sort of caffeinated beverages...
french: Je déconseille de donner la moindre boisson contenant de la caféine à Taliferro...
russian: Талиферро я бы порекомендовала воздержаться от бодрящих напитков...
bulgarian: I don't recommend giving Taliferro any sort of caffeinated beverages...

english: But Taliferro looks like he could benefit from a visit to the Bathhouse.
french: Mais je pense qu'une petite visite aux bains ferait le plus grand bien à Taliferro.
russian: Талиферро, кажется, не помешало бы сходить в купальню.
bulgarian: But Taliferro looks like he could benefit from a visit to the Bathhouse.

english: That fellow needs to relax.
french: Ce garçon a grand besoin de se détendre.
russian: Ему надо расслабиться.
bulgarian: That fellow needs to relax.

english: I'm loath to give Juniper credit...
french: Ça me fait mal d'aller dans le sens de Juniper...
russian: Мне не в радость поощрять Джунипер, но...
bulgarian: I'm loath to give Juniper credit...

english: Vera's hair dye is all natural and has no adverse effects on your health. In case you were wondering, [Ari].
french: Si jamais tu te posais la question, sache que toutes les teintures de Vera sont naturelles et ne sont pas nocives, [Ari].
russian: Краска для волос Веры полностью натуральна и не вредит здоровью. Если тебе вдруг интересно, [Ari].
bulgarian: Vera's hair dye is all natural and has no adverse effects on your health. In case you were wondering, [Ari].

english: I like my hair short, so I come to Vera as often as I can.
french: Je préfère avoir les cheveux courts, c'est pour cela que je viens voir Vera aussi souvent que possible.
russian: Мне нравится короткая стрижка, так что я стараюсь бывать у Веры как можно чаще.
bulgarian: I like my hair short, so I come to Vera as often as I can.

english: Vera gives me the same cut every time and never badgers me to change it. I appreciate that.
french: Elle me fait à chaque fois la même coupe et n'essaie jamais de me convaincre d'en changer. J'apprécie vraiment.
russian: Вера делает мне одну и ту же стрижку каждый раз и никогда не уговаривает на перемены. Я благодарна ей за это.
bulgarian: Vera gives me the same cut every time and never badgers me to change it. I appreciate that.

english: Vera's doing a lot of cutting and dyeing today... I showed her some stretches to keep her hands nice and open. Why don't you take a minute and do the same?
french: Vera enchaîne les coupes et les colorations, aujourd'hui... Je lui ai enseigné quelques étirements pour soulager ses mains. Tu devrais essayer, toi aussi.
russian: Вера сегодня много стрижёт и красит... я показала ей пару упражнений, чтобы кисти оставались в порядке. Может, и тебе стоит сделать перерыв?
bulgarian: Vera's doing a lot of cutting and dyeing today... I showed her some stretches to keep her hands nice and open. Why don't you take a minute and do the same?

english: I'm certain that man has never received a single certificate in food safety.
french: Je suis convaincue que ce type n'a jamais eu la moindre formation en hygiène alimentaire.
russian: Я уверена, что у этого человека нет никаких сертификатов о продовольственной безопасности.
bulgarian: I'm certain that man has never received a single certificate in food safety.

english: As a doctor, I can't advise consuming anything Wheedle sells at his stall.
french: En tant que médecin, je te déconseille de manger quoi que ce soit acheté sur le stand de Wheedle.
russian: Как врач я не могу рекомендовать никакую продукцию из лавки Хлюста.
bulgarian: As a doctor, I can't advise consuming anything Wheedle sells at his stall.

english: Ah well. There's no accounting for taste.
french: Mais bon... Chacun ses goûts, comme on dit.
russian: Но что ж. О вкусах не спорят.
bulgarian: Ah well. There's no accounting for taste.

english: I can't imagine where Wheedle buys his suits, but it certainly isn't from any tailors I'm acquainted with.
french: J'ignore où Wheedle achète ses costumes, mais ça ne vient d'aucun tailleur que je connais.
russian: Даже не представляю, где Хлюст берёт свои костюмы. Точно не у кого-то, кого я знаю.
bulgarian: I can't imagine where Wheedle buys his suits, but it certainly isn't from any tailors I'm acquainted with.

english: I'm doubtful that anything in his inventory has undergone any clinical trials or stress-testing.
french: Cela me surprendrait qu'un seul de ses produits ait fait l'objet d'essais cliniques.
russian: Сомневаюсь, что его товары проходили хоть какие-то клинические испытания или тесты.
bulgarian: I'm doubtful that anything in his inventory has undergone any clinical trials or stress-testing.

english: If you buy anything from Wheedle's booth, please do so at your own discretion.
french: Si jamais tu achètes quoi que ce soit provenant du stand de Wheedle, ce sera à tes risques et périls.
russian: Если будешь покупать что-то у Хлюста, то только на свой страх и риск.
bulgarian: If you buy anything from Wheedle's booth, please do so at your own discretion.

english: Don't let it get around, but I'd trust Juniper over Wheedle any day of the week.
french: Ne le répète à personne, mais j'ai cent fois plus confiance en elle qu'en Wheedle.
russian: Джунипер я доверяю гораздо больше, чем Хлюсту. Только никому не говори.
bulgarian: Don't let it get around, but I'd trust Juniper over Wheedle any day of the week.

english: Do I think Wheedle's wares are more dangerous than those mystery salves Juniper peddles around town?
french: Pardon ? Si je pense que les produits de Wheedle sont plus nocifs que les remèdes de bonne femme de Juniper ?
russian: Опаснее ли товары Хлюста чудодейственных мазей, которые продаёт жителям Джунипер?
bulgarian: Do I think Wheedle's wares are more dangerous than those mystery salves Juniper peddles around town?

bulgarian: You know, [Ari]... never in my life did I expect to raise a child.

english: To that end, I swung by Hayden's farm and the Inn and gathered a variety of food options. Does anything catch your eye?
french: C'est pour cela que je suis passée à la ferme d'Hayden et à l'auberge pour te laisser le choix. Que veux-tu ?
russian: На этот случай я зашла к Хейдену на ферму и в трактир и набрала разных вариантов. Тебе чего-нибудь хочется?
bulgarian: To that end, I swung by Hayden's farm and the Inn and gathered a variety of food options. Does anything catch your eye?

english: That Hardboiled Egg...
french: Cet œuf dur...
russian: Вон то варёное яйцо...
bulgarian: That Hardboiled Egg...

english: Oh! Spicy Cheddar Biscuit, please!
french: Oh ! Donne-moi ce biscuit épicé au cheddar, s'il te plaît !
russian: О! Дай мне острый сырный бисквит, пожалуйста!
bulgarian: Oh! Spicy Cheddar Biscuit, please!

english: That Breaded Catfish looks inviting...
french: Ce poisson-chat pané a l'air appétissant...
russian: Сом в панировке выглядит аппетитно...
bulgarian: That Breaded Catfish looks inviting...

english: It's yours to take, and I'll be sure to pick up some more the next time I'm out.
french: Il est à toi, j'en prendrai plus la prochaine fois que je sortirai.
russian: Бери на здоровье. В следующий раз возьму с запасом.
bulgarian: It's yours to take, and I'll be sure to pick up some more the next time I'm out.

english: Oho... I'm happy to see that pregnancy hasn't diminished your sense of adventure.
french: Oh ho... Je suis heureuse de voir que la grossesse n'a pas eu raison de ton goût pour l'aventure.
russian: Ого... Рада, что беременность не смогла победить твой дух авантюризма.
bulgarian: Oho... I'm happy to see that pregnancy hasn't diminished your sense of adventure.

english: Enjoy this one, and I'll be sure to bring you more biscuits the next time I swing by the Inn.
french: Régale-toi ! Je me note de t'apporter d'autres biscuits la prochaine fois que j'irai à l'auberge.
russian: Возьми пока этот, а я захвачу ещё бисквитов, когда в следующий раз зайду в трактир.
bulgarian: Enjoy this one, and I'll be sure to bring you more biscuits the next time I swing by the Inn.

english: Does it? I'm happy to hear it.
french: Vraiment ? Je suis ravie de l'entendre.
russian: Правда? Приятно слышать.
bulgarian: Does it? I'm happy to hear it.

english: Go on, then. And I'll be sure to buy out all the Breaded Catfish in town the next time I'm running errands.
french: Régale-toi ! La prochaine fois que je ferai des courses, j'achèterai tous les poissons-chats panés que je trouverai en ville.
russian: Тогда бери. А я скуплю всех сомов в панировке, когда в следующий раз буду в городе.
bulgarian: Go on, then. And I'll be sure to buy out all the Breaded Catfish in town the next time I'm running errands.

english: If memory serves, the timing is right for cravings to kick in.
french: Si ma mémoire est bonne, nous sommes à la période à laquelle tu devrais commencer à ressentir des envies soudaines.
russian: Если я правильно помню, у тебя сейчас должна появиться тяга к какой-то еде.
bulgarian: If memory serves, the timing is right for cravings to kick in.

english: Here, take this. And if you'd like more, please don't hesitate to ask.
french: Tiens, prends ça. Et si tu en veux plus, n'hésite pas à me le dire.
russian: Вот, прими этот сироп. И, если понадобится ещё, спрашивай, не стесняйся.
bulgarian: Here, take this. And if you'd like more, please don't hesitate to ask.

english: It's my job to take care of you... both of you.
french: Il est de mon devoir de m'occuper de toi... de vous deux.
russian: В мою работу входит забота о тебе... о вас обоих.
bulgarian: It's my job to take care of you... both of you.

english: I recognize the signs of morning sickness, [Ari].
french: Je reconnais les symptômes des nausées matinales, [Ari].
russian: Я замечаю признаки утренней тошноты, [Ari].
bulgarian: I recognize the signs of morning sickness, [Ari].

english: How do you feel you're coming along?
french: Comment se déroule la grossesse ?
russian: Как ты себя сейчас чувствуешь?
bulgarian: How do you feel you're coming along?

english: The baby seems bigger.
french: Le bébé a l'air de grandir.
russian: Малыш как будто стал больше.
bulgarian: The baby seems bigger.

english: My clothes feel tighter?
french: Mes vêtements me serrent un peu.
russian: Одежда стала теснее?
bulgarian: My clothes feel tighter?

english: I feel good!
french: Je me sens bien !
russian: Чувствую себя отлично!
bulgarian: I feel good!

english: I'm thrilled to hear it.
french: Je suis ravie de l'entendre.
russian: Ужасно рада слышать.
bulgarian: I'm thrilled to hear it.

english: I won't be a bother, but do let me know if there's anything I can do for you.
french: Je ne veux pas t'ennuyer, mais si je peux faire quoi que ce soit pour toi, n'hésite pas.
russian: Не буду тебе докучать, но ты мне сообщи, если я могу тебе как-то помочь.
bulgarian: I won't be a bother, but do let me know if there's anything I can do for you.

english: I consider it my duty, you know.
french: Je considère qu'il en va de mon devoir, tu sais.
russian: Ты знаешь, для меня это вопрос врачебного долга.
bulgarian: I consider it my duty, you know.

english: That's great news. It means things are progressing well.
french: Quelle bonne nouvelle ! Cela signifie que tout se passe bien.
russian: Это хорошая новость. Значит, всё идёт, как должно.
bulgarian: That's great news. It means things are progressing well.

english: And if I may cease speaking as your physician...
french: Et si tu me permets de te parler en tant qu'épouse et non en tant que docteure...
russian: И, если позволишь мне вновь вернуться к роли супруги...
bulgarian: And if I may cease speaking as your physician...

english: Do let me know if I can rub your back? Carrying the weight of an extra person puts a lot of stress on the lumbar.
french: Dis-moi si tu veux que je te masse le dos, entendu ? Porter un enfant est très exigeant pour les lombaires.
russian: Тебе не надо помассировать спину? Вес ещё одного маленького человека даёт большую нагрузку на поясницу.
bulgarian: Do let me know if I can rub your back? Carrying the weight of an extra person puts a lot of stress on the lumbar.

english: That's great news. It means things are progressing well.
french: Quelle bonne nouvelle ! Cela signifie que tout se passe bien.
russian: Это хорошая новость. Значит, всё идёт, как должно.
bulgarian: That's great news. It means things are progressing well.

english: And if I may cease speaking as your physician...
french: Et si tu me permets de te parler en tant qu'épouse et non en tant que docteure...
russian: И, если позволишь мне вновь вернуться к роли супруги...
bulgarian: And if I may cease speaking as your physician...

english: Louis taught me a little about tailoring and mending my coats, so I can let some of your clothes out if need be.
french: Louis m'a appris à faire quelques retouches sur mes tenues, donc je peux élargir certains de tes vêtements, au besoin.
russian: Я чуть-чуть подучилась у Луи, чтобы распускать и перешивать свои халаты. Так что я могу сделать тебе одежду посвободнее, если понадобится.
bulgarian: Louis taught me a little about tailoring and mending my coats, so I can let some of your clothes out if need be.

english: I think.
french: Enfin, je crois.
russian: Думаю, я справлюсь.
bulgarian: I think.

english: Well, just let me know.
french: Bref, tu n'as qu'à me le dire.
russian: В общем, обращайся.
bulgarian: Well, just let me know.

english: I apologize [Ari]. I must speak for a moment not as your spouse, but as your physician.
french: Je suis désolée, [Ari]. Je dois te parler non en tant qu'épouse, mais en tant que docteure.
russian: Прошу простить, [Ari]. Я временно выйду из роли твоей супруги и приму роль врача.
bulgarian: I apologize [Ari]. I must speak for a moment not as your spouse, but as your physician.

english: Oh... now isn't that remarkable?
french: Oh... C'est incroyable, non ?
russian: Ого... просто поразительно!
bulgarian: Oh... now isn't that remarkable?

english: I mean... it's perfectly typical, a baby kicking in vivo. This is quite ordinary.
french: Je veux dire... il est tout à fait normal qu'un bébé donne des coups de pied in utero. C'est même quelque chose d'ordinaire.
russian: То есть... Для малышей совершенно естественно пинаться в чреве. В этом нет ничего необычного.
bulgarian: I mean... it's perfectly typical, a baby kicking in vivo. This is quite ordinary.

english: But this is the first time I've experienced it with my own child. Which to me... is extraordinary.
french: C'est néanmoins la première fois que j'en fais l'expérience avec mon propre enfant. Je trouve ça extraordinaire.
russian: Но я впервые ощущаю пинки моего собственного ребёнка. Для меня это... удивительное чувство.
bulgarian: But this is the first time I've experienced it with my own child. Which to me... is extraordinary.

english: Oh, is the baby kicking? Can I put my hand on your stomach?
french: Oh, le bébé donne des coups de pied ? Je peux poser ma main sur ton ventre ?
russian: О, малыш начал пинаться? Могу я положить руку тебе на живот?
bulgarian: Oh, is the baby kicking? Can I put my hand on your stomach?

english: I know it's a bit sentimental, but... if we had a boy, would you be open to calling him "$Torin$"? It was my father's name.
french: Je sais que ça a un côté sentimental, mais si c'est un garçon, serais-tu d'accord pour l'appeler « $Torin$ » ? C'était le prénom de mon père.
russian: Я знаю, прозвучит сентиментально, но... если у нас будет мальчик, ты согласишься назвать его $Торин$? Так звали моего отца.
bulgarian: I know it's a bit sentimental, but... if we had a boy, would you be open to calling him "$Torin$"? It was my father's name.

english: Of course, this isn't a demand... it's a decision for both of us to make together.
french: Bien évidemment, je ne t'oblige à rien... c'est une décision que nous devons prendre ensemble.
russian: Разумеется, я ничего не требую... Мы должны посоветоваться и вместе принять решение.
bulgarian: Of course, this isn't a demand... it's a decision for both of us to make together.

english: And there's no need for us to decide now.
french: Et nous n'avons pas à nous précipiter.
russian: И пока что решать ещё рано.
bulgarian: And there's no need for us to decide now.

english: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.
french: [Ari], j'ai réfléchi à des prénoms pour le bébé.
russian: [Ari]... Я раздумывала над именем для малыша.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.

english: Everything is ready, so just let me know when it's time.
french: Tout est prêt, alors tu n'auras qu'à me prévenir quand le moment sera venu.
russian: У меня всё готово. Просто скажи, когда всё начнётся.
bulgarian: Everything is ready, so just let me know when it's time.

english: I suspect the baby will be joining us soon, [Ari].
french: J'ai l'impression que le bébé sera bientôt parmi nous, [Ari].
russian: Подозреваю, что малыш скоро придёт к нам, [Ari].
bulgarian: I suspect the baby will be joining us soon, [Ari].

english: Goodness, what amazing news!
french: Ça alors, quelle super nouvelle !
russian: Ну и ну, это же потрясающая новость!
bulgarian: Goodness, what amazing news!

english: I hope you'll allow me the pleasure of being their honorary uncle. After all, no one gives better piggyback rides than ol' Hayden!
french: J'espère que je serai tonton à titre honorifique. Après tout, personne ne porte mieux les enfants sur son dos que moi !
russian: Надеюсь, вы позволите мне занять роль почётного дядюшки. В конце концов, кто лучше Хейдена покатает на спине?
bulgarian: I hope you'll allow me the pleasure of being their honorary uncle. After all, no one gives better piggyback rides than ol' Hayden!

english: Gya ha ha!
french: Gah ha ha !
russian: Га-ха-ха!
bulgarian: Gya ha ha!

english: Is it true, [Ari]? You and Valen are going to have a baby?
french: C'est vrai, [Ari] ? Valen et toi allez avoir un bébé ?
russian: Это правда, [Ari]? У вас с Вален будет ребёнок?
bulgarian: Is it true, [Ari]? You and Valen are going to have a baby?

english: You and Valen? A baby? How wonderful!
french: Valen et toi attendez un bébé ? C'est fantastique !
russian: У тебя с Вален? Ребёнок? Чудесно!
bulgarian: You and Valen? A baby? How wonderful!

english: Wouldn't it be something if a child of Valen's inherited your knack for magic?
french: Ce serait drôle qu'un enfant de Valen hérite de ton don pour la magie, non ?
russian: Вот будет номер, если ребёнок Вален унаследует твои магические способности!
bulgarian: Wouldn't it be something if a child of Valen's inherited your knack for magic?

english: Ohohoho!
french: Oh ho ho !
russian: О-хо-хо-хо!
bulgarian: Ohohoho!

english: [Ari], I just heard the news!
french: [Ari], je suis au courant de la nouvelle !
russian: [Ari], я только что узнала!
bulgarian: [Ari], I just heard the news!

english: Valen's old man, Torin, would be over the moon to hear he's becoming a grandpa.
french: Torin, le père de Valen, serait aux anges s'il savait qu'il était sur le point de devenir grand-père.
russian: Старина Торин, отец Вален, сейчас бы так обрадовался, узнав, что станет дедушкой.
bulgarian: Valen's old man, Torin, would be over the moon to hear he's becoming a grandpa.

english: Errol and I will make sure to toast him tonight! And the baby too, of course!
french: Je porterai un toast en son honneur avec Errol, ce soir. Et à l'arrivée du bébé, bien sûr !
russian: Сегодня мы с Эрролом обязательно поднимем за него тост! И за малыша, конечно же!
bulgarian: Errol and I will make sure to toast him tonight! And the baby too, of course!

english: Oho, congratulations are in order! Good tidings on you and Valen!
french: Oh ho, les félicitations sont de mise ! Quelle heureuse nouvelle pour Valen et toi !
russian: Хо-хо, мои вам поздравления! Всех благ тебе и Вален!
bulgarian: Oho, congratulations are in order! Good tidings on you and Valen!

english: Does that mean your baby's going to be half doctor?
french: Ça veut dire que votre enfant sera à moitié docteur ?
russian: Это же значит, что ваш ребёнок будет наполовину доктор?
bulgarian: Does that mean your baby's going to be half doctor?

english: Then I decree that they shall be my royal court physician when they grow up!
french: Dans ce cas, je décrète qu'une fois adulte, ce sera mon médecin officiel à la cour !
russian: Тогда я издам указ, что он станет моим придворным врачом, когда вырастет!
bulgarian: Then I decree that they shall be my royal court physician when they grow up!

english: I heard you and Doctor Valen are having a baby! That's great!
french: Il paraît que la docteure Valen et toi allez avoir un bébé ! C'est génial !
russian: Я слышала, что у вас с доктором Вален будет малыш! Это замечательно!
bulgarian: I heard you and Doctor Valen are having a baby! That's great!

english: But now that I am, it's tremendously exciting.
french: Mais maintenant que c'est le cas, je ressens une impatience incroyable.
russian: А теперь я беременна и это буквально наполняет меня предвкушением.
bulgarian: But now that I am, it's tremendously exciting.

english: And you are the only one I would have ever considered sharing it with.
french: Et tu es la seule personne avec laquelle j'ai jamais songé à partager cela.
russian: Этими чувствами я не готова делиться ни с кем, кроме тебе.
bulgarian: And you are the only one I would have ever considered sharing it with.

english: Ah, this is thrilling. I should keep notes.
french: Ah, c'est exaltant. Je devrais prendre des notes.
russian: Ах, как я взволнована. Надо вести дневник своего состояния.
bulgarian: Ah, this is thrilling. I should keep notes.

english: You know, [Ari]... never in my life did I expect to carry a baby.
french: Tu sais, [Ari]... De toute ma vie, je n'avais jamais envisagé l'idée de porter un enfant.
russian: Знаешь, [Ari]... Я никогда в жизни не думала, что буду вынашивать ребёнка.
bulgarian: You know, [Ari]... never in my life did I expect to carry a baby.

english: I expected this might be the case... pregnancy cravings are quite well-documented, after all.
french: J'imaginais que cela arriverait. Ce sont des phénomènes bien connus lors d'une grossesse.
russian: Я предполагала, что это может случиться... Тяга к еде при беременности широко описана в медицинской практике.
bulgarian: I expected this might be the case... pregnancy cravings are quite well-documented, after all.

english: Perhaps it's just arbitrary?
french: Ou peut-être est-ce totalement arbitraire ?
russian: Может, это произвольный феномен?
bulgarian: Perhaps it's just arbitrary?

english: I'm taking extensive notes.
french: Je prends des notes très détaillées.
russian: Я подробно задокументирую свой опыт.
bulgarian: I'm taking extensive notes.

english: But it's another thing entirely to experience them first-hand.
french: Mais en faire l'expérience soi-même, c'est autre chose.
russian: Но почувствовать её на себе — это совершенно другое.
bulgarian: But it's another thing entirely to experience them first-hand.

english: On that note... would you be an angel and get me a $Grilled Cheese$? It's all I can think about.
french: À ce propos, aurais-tu la gentillesse de m'apporter un $croque au fromage$ ? Je n'arrive pas à penser à autre chose.
russian: К слову... Будь ангелом, принеси мне, пожалуйста, $Горячий сэндвич с сыром$. Я только о нём и думаю.
bulgarian: On that note... would you be an angel and get me a $Grilled Cheese$? It's all I can think about.

english: Really? You don't normally like them.
french: Vraiment ? Tu n'aimes pas ça d'habitude.
russian: Серьёзно? Обычно ты такое не ешь.
bulgarian: Really? You don't normally like them.

english: I'll get on it right away!
french: Tout de suite !
russian: Принесу сейчас же!
bulgarian: I'll get on it right away!

english: I know! Isn't it fascinating?
french: En effet ! C'est fascinant, pas vrai ?
russian: Я знаю! Любопытно, правда?
bulgarian: I know! Isn't it fascinating?

english: I wonder if it's a nutritional need? A caloric need?
french: Je me demande si c'est un besoin nutritif ou un besoin en calories.
russian: Интересно, это потребность в специфических веществах? Или в калориях?
bulgarian: I wonder if it's a nutritional need? A caloric need?

english: Perhaps it's simply arbitrary?
french: Ou peut-être est-ce totalement arbitraire ?
russian: Может, это произвольный феномен?
bulgarian: Perhaps it's simply arbitrary?

english: I'm taking extensive notes.
french: Je prends des notes très détaillées.
russian: Я подробно задокументирую свой опыт.
bulgarian: I'm taking extensive notes.

english: Wonderful! Thank you, [Ari].
french: Fabuleux ! Merci, [Ari].
russian: Чудесно! Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Wonderful! Thank you, [Ari].

english: I don't normally enjoy them... I wonder if the cravings are a nutritional need? A caloric need?
french: D'habitude, je n'aime pas ça... Je me demande si c'est un besoin nutritif ou un besoin en calories.
russian: Обычно они мне не нравятся... Интересно, это потребность в специфических веществах? Или в калориях?
bulgarian: I don't normally enjoy them... I wonder if the cravings are a nutritional need? A caloric need?

english: I'm experiencing intense cravings, [Ari].
french: J'ai des envies soudaines, [Ari].
russian: Я испытываю сильную тягу к еде, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'm experiencing intense cravings, [Ari].

english: The morning sickness has arrived.
french: Les nausées matinales ont commencé.
russian: Меня настигла утренняя тошнота.
bulgarian: The morning sickness has arrived.

english: It's fine. I've taken a syrup, and will take the day slowly.
french: Tout ira bien. J'ai pris un sirop et je me ménagerai pendant la journée.
russian: Всё хорошо. Я приняла нужный сироп и постараюсь сегодня не напрягаться.
bulgarian: It's fine. I've taken a syrup, and will take the day slowly.

english: This is all tremendously valuable data, so I will persevere through the discomfort.
french: Mais ce sont des informations très intéressantes, alors je surmonterai ce désagrément.
russian: Я переживу свой дискомфорт, ведь это невероятно ценные данные.
bulgarian: This is all tremendously valuable data, so I will persevere through the discomfort.

english: Ah, [Ari]... I knew this day would come.
french: Ah, [Ari]... Je savais que ce jour finirait par arriver.
russian: Ах, [Ari]... Я знала, что этот день наступит.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]... I knew this day would come.

english: Oh no, this is not an issue of vanity. Simply my objective observation.
french: Oh, ce n'est pas une question de vanité, mais une observation objective.
russian: О, нет, меня не волнует внешний вид. Просто делаю наблюдения.
bulgarian: Oh no, this is not an issue of vanity. Simply my objective observation.

english: Things are progressing as they should. I'm exactly on schedule for a singleton baby, and there's no history of twins in my family.
french: Les choses évoluent dans le bon sens. Tout indique que je n'aurai qu'un seul enfant, je n'ai pas connaissance de jumeaux dans ma famille.
russian: Дела идут естественным путём. Всё точь-в-точь по графику для малыша-одиночки, а двойняшек в моей семье ещё не было.
bulgarian: Things are progressing as they should. I'm exactly on schedule for a singleton baby, and there's no history of twins in my family.

english: It's all very good news.
french: Ce sont de très bonnes nouvelles.
russian: Всё это — успокаивающие известия.
bulgarian: It's all very good news.

english: The baby has grown quite a bit lately. My clothing is tighter, have you noticed?
french: Le bébé a beaucoup grandi, ces derniers jours. Je sens que mes vêtements me serrent. Est-ce que ça se voit ?
russian:
В последнее время малыш существенно вырос. Одежда стала теснее, ты не

заметили

заметилазаметилзаметило?
bulgarian: The baby has grown quite a bit lately. My clothing is tighter, have you noticed?

english: The baby's kicking! Do you feel it? Isn't it remarkable?
french: Le bébé donne des coups de pied ! Tu le sens ? C'est incroyable, non ?
russian: Малыш пинается! Ты чувствуешь? Поразительно, правда?
bulgarian: The baby's kicking! Do you feel it? Isn't it remarkable?

english: I mean... it's perfectly typical, a baby kicking in vivo. This is quite ordinary.
french: Enfin, c'est tout à fait normal qu'un bébé donne des coups de pied in utero. C'est même quelque chose d'ordinaire.
russian: То есть... Для малышей совершенно естественно пинаться в чреве. В этом нет ничего необычного.
bulgarian: I mean... it's perfectly typical, a baby kicking in vivo. This is quite ordinary.

english: But this is the first time I've experienced it. Which, to me... is extraordinary.
french: En revanche, c'est la première fois que je vis ça. Pour moi, c'est incroyable.
russian: Но я впервые ощущаю пинки в собственном теле. Для меня это... удивительное чувство.
bulgarian: But this is the first time I've experienced it. Which, to me... is extraordinary.

english: [Ari]! Come quickly. Put your hand on my stomach.
french: [Ari] ! Viens vite. Pose ta main sur mon ventre.
russian: [Ari]! Подойди скорее. Положи руку мне на живот.
bulgarian: [Ari]! Come quickly. Put your hand on my stomach.

english: I know it's a bit sentimental, but... if we were to have a boy, would you be open to calling him "$Torin$"? It was my father's name.
french: Je sais que ça a un côté sentimental, mais... si jamais c'est un garçon, serais-tu d'accord pour l'appeler « $Torin$ » ? C'était le prénom de mon père.
russian: Я знаю, прозвучит сентиментально, но... если у нас будет мальчик, ты согласишься назвать его $Торин$? Так звали моего отца.
bulgarian: I know it's a bit sentimental, but... if we were to have a boy, would you be open to calling him "$Torin$"? It was my father's name.

english: Of course, this isn't a demand... it's a decision for both of us to make together.
french: Bien évidemment, je ne t'oblige à rien... C'est une décision que nous devons prendre ensemble.
russian: Разумеется, я ничего не требую... Мы должны посоветоваться и вместе принять решение.
bulgarian: Of course, this isn't a demand... it's a decision for both of us to make together.

english: And there's no need for us to decide now.
french: Et nous n'avons pas à nous précipiter.
russian: И пока что решать ещё рано.
bulgarian: And there's no need for us to decide now.

english: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.
french: [Ari], j'ai réfléchi à des prénoms pour le bébé.
russian: [Ari]... Я раздумывала над именем для малыша.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.

english: I have prepared everything with Josephine and Terithia, but...
french: J'ai pris soin de tout préparer avec l'aide de Joséphine et Terithia, mais...
russian: Мы с Джозефиной и Теризией всё приготовили, но...
bulgarian: I have prepared everything with Josephine and Terithia, but...

english: Well, I would feel psychologically supported if you were close at hand over the next few days.
french: Eh bien, ta présence non loin de moi dans les jours à venir m'apporterait un soutien psychologique.
russian: Мне будет психологически комфортнее, если ты будешь рядом в ближайшие дни.
bulgarian: Well, I would feel psychologically supported if you were close at hand over the next few days.

english: [Ari], based on an assessment of my bodily condition and my notes, I believe the baby should be arriving very soon.
french: [Ari], si j'en crois mon état et les notes que j'ai prises, je crois que le bébé ne tardera pas à arriver.
russian: [Ari], согласно по моим заметкам и наблюдениям за физическим состояние, я полагаю, что малыш должен появиться очень скоро.
bulgarian: [Ari], based on an assessment of my bodily condition and my notes, I believe the baby should be arriving very soon.

english: But now that we are expectant parents, I'm tremendously excited.
french: Mais maintenant que nous allons devenir parents, je suis si impatiente.
russian: Но теперь, когда мы почти родители, я буквально наполнена предвкушением.
bulgarian: But now that we are expectant parents, I'm tremendously excited.

english: You should know... you are the only one I would have ever considered sharing this with.
french: Sache que tu es la seule personne avec laquelle j'ai jamais songé à partager cela.
russian: Тебе следует знать, что... Этими чувствами я не готова делиться ни с кем, кроме тебе.
bulgarian: You should know... you are the only one I would have ever considered sharing this with.

english: I'm unused to such a cocktail of emotions. How thrilling!
french: Je ne suis pas habituée à ressentir des émotions aussi différentes. C'est exaltant !
russian: Такой букет эмоций для меня крайне непривычен. Я очень взволнована!
bulgarian: I'm unused to such a cocktail of emotions. How thrilling!

english: You know, [Ari]... never in my life did I expect to raise a child.
french: Tu sais, [Ari]... De toute ma vie, je n'avais jamais envisagé d'élever un enfant.
russian: Знаешь, [Ari]... Я никогда в жизни не думала, что заведу ребёнка.
bulgarian: You know, [Ari]... never in my life did I expect to raise a child.

english: It will be nice to use it for bottles and pacifiers, instead of...
french: Ce sera plus sympa de l'utiliser pour les biberons et les tétines que pour...
russian: Приятно использовать его для бутылочек и сосок, а не...
bulgarian: It will be nice to use it for bottles and pacifiers, instead of...

english: Well, instead of the other, less adorable things I normally disinfect.
french: Bref, que pour les choses moins charmantes que je dois habituellement stériliser.
russian: В общем, на менее симпатичных предметах, обычно требующих дезинфекции.
bulgarian: Well, instead of the other, less adorable things I normally disinfect.

english: In preparation for the baby's arrival, I brought back the disinfecting kit from my old lab.
french: En vue de l'arrivée du bébé, j'ai apporté mon kit de stérilisation de mon ancien laboratoire.
russian: Я решила подготовиться к прибытию малыша и принесла из своей старой лаборатории набор для дезинфекции.
bulgarian: In preparation for the baby's arrival, I brought back the disinfecting kit from my old lab.

english: I enjoy their company, but I'm always afraid I don't have a lot in common with them. I never know how to act.
french: J'apprécie leur compagnie, mais j'ai toujours peur de ne pas avoir grand-chose à leur dire. Je ne sais jamais comment me comporter.
russian: Мне нравится быть с ними рядом, но обычно я переживаю, что у нас мало общего. Никогда не знаю, как себя вести.
bulgarian: I enjoy their company, but I'm always afraid I don't have a lot in common with them. I never know how to act.

english: That's true... I'll be able to learn by our neighbors' example.
french: C'est vrai... Je devrais pouvoir apprendre en prenant exemple sur nos voisins.
russian: Это правда... Я могу научиться, полагаясь на опыт наших соседей.
bulgarian: That's true... I'll be able to learn by our neighbors' example.

english: I'm an excellent study. Even if I'm inexperienced, I'll learn as I go.
french: Je suis très observatrice. Même si je n'ai aucune expérience, j'apprends sur le tas.
russian: Я исключительно быстро учусь. Мне недостаёт опыта, но я освоюсь по ходу.
bulgarian: I'm an excellent study. Even if I'm inexperienced, I'll learn as I go.

english: I suppose that's what they mean by the phrase "fake it until you make it."
french: Après tout, ne dit-on pas qu'il faut persévérer jusqu'à ce que ça marche ?
russian: Видимо, как раз в таких случаях говорят: «притворяйся, пока это не станет правдой».
bulgarian: I suppose that's what they mean by the phrase "fake it until you make it."

english: In short, I'm worried about my abilities as a parent.
french: Pour faire court, je me fais du souci quant à mes compétences en tant que mère.
russian: Короче говоря, я сомневаюсь в своих родительских способностях.
bulgarian: In short, I'm worried about my abilities as a parent.

english: What if I can't connect with our child? Or worse... what if they find me boring?
french: Et si jamais je n'arrive pas à tisser de lien avec notre enfant ? Ou pire... s'il me trouve ennuyeuse ?
russian: Что если я не смогу наладить связь с ребёнком? Или ещё хуже... что если он посчитает меня занудой?
bulgarian: What if I can't connect with our child? Or worse... what if they find me boring?

english: Don't worry, I know you'll do great!
french: Ne t'en fais pas, je sais que tu t'en sortiras très bien !
russian: Не волнуйся, я знаю, у тебя всё получится!
bulgarian: Don't worry, I know you'll do great!

english: We'll figure it out together!
french: Nous y arriverons ensemble !
russian: Мы справимся с этим вместе!
bulgarian: We'll figure it out together!

english: We have a whole community to rely on!
french: Nous pouvons compter sur tous nos voisins !
russian: У нас вокруг целый город помощников!
bulgarian: We have a whole community to rely on!

правы

праваправправо.

russian: Ты не против, если я буду учиться у тебя? Я исключительно быстро учусь. Мне недостаёт опыта, но я освоюсь по ходу.

russian: Видимо, как раз в таких случаях говорят: «притворяйся, пока это не станет правдой».
bulgarian: I suppose that's what they mean when they say, "fake it until you make it."

french: J'espère que ça ne te dérangera pas que je prenne exemple sur toi. Je suis très observatrice. Même si je n'ai aucune expérience, j'apprends sur le tas.

bulgarian: I suppose that's what they mean by the phrase "fake it until you make it."

french: [Ari], je veux que tu saches que je n'ai pas beaucoup d'expérience avec les enfants.
russian: [Ari]... Тебе следует знать: у меня небогатый опыт обращения с детьми.
bulgarian: [Ari]... you should know, I don't have a great deal of experience with children.

english: Feeding schedules, sleeping schedules, keeping journals and timers...
french: Les heures pour lui donner à manger, pour la sieste, tenir un journal, tout chronométrer...
russian: График кормления, график сна, всякие журналы и будильники...
bulgarian: Feeding schedules, sleeping schedules, keeping journals and timers...

english: I suppose he's bottle-reared his share of calves and lambs. He probably has more experience with babies than the whole town combined.
french: J'imagine qu'il a dû donner le biberon à bon nombre de veaux et d'agneaux. Il a sûrement plus d'expérience avec les bébés que tous les habitants réunis.
russian: Что ж, на своём веку он приучил к бутылке множество телят и барашков. Вероятно, его опыт в обращении с малышами богаче, чем у всех остальных мистрийцев вместе взятых.
bulgarian: I suppose he's bottle-reared his share of calves and lambs. He probably has more experience with babies than the whole town combined.

english: Hayden has been showering me with all sorts of advice in anticipation of our baby's arrival...
french: Hayden m'a prodigué de nombreux conseils en vue de l'arrivée de notre bébé...
russian: Хейден засыпал меня советами к появлению нашего ребёнка...
bulgarian: Hayden has been showering me with all sorts of advice in anticipation of our baby's arrival...

english: Especially when a child is young, their appearance and personality changes month by month, year by year.
french: Surtout chez un enfant si jeune, son physique et sa personnalité changent mois après mois.
russian: Особенно когда ребёнок ещё маленький. И внешность, и характер меняются месяц от месяца, год от года.
bulgarian: Especially when a child is young, their appearance and personality changes month by month, year by year.

english: Still, I hope they take after you, [Ari].
french: J'espère toutefois que notre enfant te ressemblera, [Ari].
russian: И всё же, я рассчитываю, что он будет похож на тебя, [Ari].
bulgarian: Still, I hope they take after you, [Ari].

english: It's often asked who the baby takes after more, but I think that's very fluid...
french: Les gens ont tendance à se demander auquel des deux parents un bébé ressemble le plus. Je crois que cela varie énormément...
russian: Многие задаются вопросом, в кого растёт малыш, но мне кажется, тут всё очень изменчиво...
bulgarian: It's often asked who the baby takes after more, but I think that's very fluid...

french: Je sais que ça a un côté sentimental, mais si c'est un garçon, serais-tu d'accord pour l'appeler « $Torin$ » ? C'était le prénom de mon père.

bulgarian: I know it's a bit sentimental, but... if we had a boy, would you be open to calling him "$Torin$"? It was my father's name.

russian: Разумеется, я ничего не требую... Мы должны посоветоваться и вместе принять решение.

bulgarian: And there's no need for us to decide now.

english: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.
french: [Ari], j'ai réfléchi à des prénoms pour le bébé.
russian: [Ari]... Я раздумывала над именем для малыша.
bulgarian: [Ari]... I've been considering baby names.

english: Everything is prepared... it's just a matter of time, now.
french: Tout est prêt... ce n'est plus qu'une question de temps, désormais.
russian: Я всё подготовила... Теперь остаётся только ждать.
bulgarian: Everything is prepared... it's just a matter of time, now.

english: I suspect the baby will be joining us soon, [Ari].
french: J'ai l'impression que le bébé sera bientôt parmi nous, [Ari].
russian: Подозреваю, что малыш скоро придёт к нам, [Ari].
bulgarian: I suspect the baby will be joining us soon, [Ari].

english: What an illuminating experiment... I mean, experience. Thank you for your help, [Ari].
french: Quelle expérience scientifique enrichissante ! Je veux dire, expérience personnelle. Merci pour ton aide, [Ari].
russian: Какой занимательный опыт я провела... Точнее, получила. Спасибо за помощь, [Ari].
bulgarian: What an illuminating experiment... I mean, experience. Thank you for your help, [Ari].

english: Perfect! This is exactly what I've been craving all day.
french: Parfait, c'est exactement ce dont j'avais envie pendant toute la journée !
russian: Прекрасно! Именно этого мне так хотелось весь день.
bulgarian: Perfect! This is exactly what I've been craving all day.

english: If you're planning on venturing into the Mines, I'd like to be mentally prepared.
french: Si tu comptes t'aventurer dans les mines, j'ai besoin de le savoir pour me préparer mentalement.
russian: Я хочу психологически подготовиться на случай, если ты собираешься в шахты.
bulgarian: If you're planning on venturing into the Mines, I'd like to be mentally prepared.

english: I'm going to take care of the farm for a bit.
french: Je vais m'occuper un peu de la ferme.
russian: Я планирую немного позаботиться о ферме.
bulgarian: I'm going to take care of the farm for a bit.

english: I was thinking of doing some foraging!
french: Je pensais aller faire de la cueillette !
russian: Я собираюсь отправиться за травами!
bulgarian: I was thinking of doing some foraging!

english: Yeah, I might go down into the Mines...
french: Effectivement, je vais peut-être aller dans les mines...
russian: Да, возможно, я спущусь в шахты...
bulgarian: Yeah, I might go down into the Mines...

english: Of course. I suppose it's only natural when you live one.
french: Oui, c'est normal quand on vit de la terre.
russian: Ну конечно. Это естественно, ведь ты живёшь с её плодов.
bulgarian: Of course. I suppose it's only natural when you live one.

english: Do say hello to the animals for me.
french: Salue les animaux de ma part !
russian: Передавай мой привет животным.
bulgarian: Do say hello to the animals for me.

english: The plants as well, if you're feeling whimsical.
french: Et aussi les plantes, si jamais tu veux y mettre un brin de fantaisie.
russian: Если будет желание, можешь и растениям передать.
bulgarian: The plants as well, if you're feeling whimsical.

english: Wonderful. You're ever adept at finding unusual plants on the outskirts of town.
french: Merveilleux ! Tu as beaucoup de talent pour dénicher des plantes rares autour de la ville.
russian: Замечательно. У тебя всегда получается находить на задворках нашей земли необычные растения.
bulgarian: Wonderful. You're ever adept at finding unusual plants on the outskirts of town.

english: If you do find anything interesting... well, you know what I like.

russian: Если найдёшь что-нибудь интересное... В общем, ты знаешь, какие травы мне нравятся.

english: Before we part for the day... what's your schedule looking like?
french: Avant qu'on se sépare pour la journée, qu'as-tu prévu de faire aujourd'hui ?
russian: Прежде, чем мы расстанемся на сегодня... Расскажи, какие у тебя планы?
bulgarian: Before we part for the day... what's your schedule looking like?

bulgarian: [Ari]! I wasn't expecting to run into you.

bulgarian: Do we need any groceries? I can stop by the General Store on the way home from the Clinic.

russian: Или можем зайти в трактир, если хочешь. Я угощаю.
bulgarian: Or we can stop by the Inn instead, if you'd like. My treat.

english: Remind me... was there something we planned on cooking tonight?
french: Rafraîchis-moi la mémoire ! Nous avions prévu quelque chose pour le dîner de ce soir ?
russian: Напомни... Мы планировали сегодня что-то приготовить?
bulgarian: Remind me... was there something we planned on cooking tonight?

english: But if it frees up your day, I'm happy to take over the task.
french: Mais si cela peut te faire gagner du temps sur ta journée, je serais ravie de m'en occuper.
russian: Но если это освободит тебе время, я готова ей заняться.
bulgarian: But if it frees up your day, I'm happy to take over the task.

english: I'm ashamed to say I've never been particularly adept at laundry...
french: J'ai un peu honte d'avouer que la lessive n'a jamais été mon point fort...
russian: Стыдно признаться, но стирка никогда не была моей сильной стороной...
bulgarian: I'm ashamed to say I've never been particularly adept at laundry...

english: You didn't come all the way out here just to give me a kiss, did you?
french: Tu as fait tout ce chemin juste pour venir m'embrasser ?
russian:
Ты что,

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло в такую даль, чтобы одарить меня поцелуем?

french: Tu es incorrigible.
russian:
Ты

неисправимы

неисправиманеисправимнеисправимо.
bulgarian: You're incorrigible.

english: Goodness, [Ari]...
french: Oh, [Ari]...
russian: Ну и ну, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Goodness, [Ari]...

french: Quelle joie de te voir et de me dire...
russian: Как же чудесно смотреть на тебя и думать...
bulgarian: It's a wonder to see you and think...

english: Thank you for making the time. I do love to see your face.
french: Merci d'avoir trouvé le temps de passer me voir. Comme j'aime regarder ton visage...
russian:
Спасибо, что

нашли

нашланашёлнашло время. Приятно посмотреть на твоё лицо.
bulgarian: Thank you for making the time. I do love to see your face.

english: You're such a darling, coming out to see me.
french: C'est vraiment adorable de ta part de venir me voir.
russian:
Какие

КакаяКакойКакое ты душечка, что
