зашлазашёлзашло ко мне.
bulgarian: You're such a darling, coming out to see me.

english: Though, they are always asking for additional pets. I suppose there's no harm in indulging that as much as you'd like.
french: Mais il veut toujours plus de caresses. Pour ça, je suppose qu'il n'y a pas de limites.
russian: Хотя [pet_name] всегда просит гладиться почаще. Думаю, за такое можно многое спустить.
bulgarian: Though, they are always asking for additional pets. I suppose there's no harm in indulging that as much as you'd like.

english: Don't let [pet_name] fool you... I've already fed them.
french: Ne te laisse pas amadouer par [pet_name], je lui ai déjà donné à manger.
russian: Пускай [pet_name] тебя не обманывает: корм я уже дала.
bulgarian: Don't let [pet_name] fool you... I've already fed them.

english: But watching them trot around the house like they own the place... it's admittedly very charming.
french: Mais j'admets que c'est mignon de voir [pet_name] se promener dans la maison...
russian: Заставляет задуматься. Разгуливает по дому с таким хозяйским видом... Признаю, в этом есть свой шарм.
bulgarian: But watching them trot around the house like they own the place... it's admittedly very charming.

english: I admire the self-assurance of a creature who doesn't pay rent.
french: Pour quelqu'un qui ne paie pas de loyer, cet animal ne manque pas d'assurance.
russian: Меня впечатляет такая самоуверенность от жильца, который не платит за место.
bulgarian: I admire the self-assurance of a creature who doesn't pay rent.

english: I had never considered having a pet before [pet_name]...
french: L'idée d'avoir un animal de compagnie ne m'avait jamais traversé l'esprit.
russian: Я никогда не думала завести питомца, но [pet_name]...
bulgarian: I had never considered having a pet before [pet_name]...

english: If you'd like to sleep in the same bed together, you need to get us a double-sized bed.
french: Si tu veux que nous dormions ensemble, il faut que tu nous trouves un lit double.
russian: Если ты хочешь, чтобы мы спали в одной постели, нам нужна двуспальная кровать.
bulgarian: If you'd like to sleep in the same bed together, you need to get us a double-sized bed.

english: Come, now. We're not living the bachelor life anymore.
french: Allez ! Nous ne sommes plus célibataires, dorénavant.
russian: Пора остепениться, мы больше не одиночки.
bulgarian: Come, now. We're not living the bachelor life anymore.

english: I appreciate you humoring my... idiosyncrasies.
french: Je te remercie de supporter mes petits caprices.
russian: Спасибо, что потакаешь моим... предпочтениям.
bulgarian: I appreciate you humoring my... idiosyncrasies.

english: The farmhouse has been looking pleasantly lived-in lately. And it's been nice to have a space to do work as the mood takes me.
french: Notre petite ferme est bien aménagée, maintenant. Je dois dire que c'est agréable d'avoir un endroit pour travailler si l'envie m'en prend.
russian: В последнее время наш дом приобрёл приятно обжитой вид. И я рада, что у меня здесь есть рабочее место на случай, если я захочу погрузиться в работу.
bulgarian: The farmhouse has been looking pleasantly lived-in lately. And it's been nice to have a space to do work as the mood takes me.

english: While it's lovely living here, I do need a space to indulge my own interests now and again. Would you mind making a place for my things?
french: J'adore vivre ici, mais j'aimerais avoir un peu de place pour m'adonner à mes passe-temps. Tu penses pouvoir m'aménager ça ?
russian:
Здесь у тебя очень мило, но иногда мне нужно место, чтобы заняться собственным и делами. Ты не

могли

могламогмогло бы найти место для моих вещей?
bulgarian: While it's lovely living here, I do need a space to indulge my own interests now and again. Would you mind making a place for my things?

english: I don't suppose you expect me to move my study back into the Clinic's root cellar, do you?
french: J'espère que tu ne t'attends pas à ce que je poursuive mes recherches dans le vieux sous-sol de la clinique, hein ?
russian: Ты же не хочешь, чтобы я перенесла свой кабинет назад в подвал клиники?
bulgarian: I don't suppose you expect me to move my study back into the Clinic's root cellar, do you?

english: So why do I still have dreams about arriving late to class and forgetting to study for a test?
french: Alors comment se fait-il que je rêve encore que j'arrive en retard aux cours ou que j'oublie d'étudier pour un examen ?
russian: Так почему же меня до сих пор преследуют сны о том, как я опаздываю или забываю подготовиться к экзамену?
bulgarian: So why do I still have dreams about arriving late to class and forgetting to study for a test?

english: It's embarrassing, really.
french: C'est vraiment très embarrassant.
russian: Об этом даже рассказывать неудобно.
bulgarian: It's embarrassing, really.

english: I haven't been a student in years...
french: Cela fait des années que j'ai fini mes études...
russian: Много лет прошло с тех пор, как я была студенткой...
bulgarian: I haven't been a student in years...

english: Would you care to join me?
french: Cela te dirait de te joindre à moi ?
russian: Составишь мне компанию?
bulgarian: Would you care to join me?

english: [Ari], there you are. I was thinking of getting ready for bed soon.
french: [Ari], te voilà. Je comptais aller me coucher bientôt.
russian: [Ari], вот ты где. Я собираюсь скоро пойти спать.
bulgarian: [Ari], there you are. I was thinking of getting ready for bed soon.

english: I suppose I could extend my office hours, if you feel yourself in need of a proper examination?
french: Je suppose que je peux reprendre du service et que je t'ausculte de près.
russian: Впрочем, я могу продлить приёмные часы, если тебе необходим осмотр.
bulgarian: I suppose I could extend my office hours, if you feel yourself in need of a proper examination?

english: [Ari], welcome home. I hope you weren't too rough on your body today...
french: [Ari], bienvenue à la maison. J'espère que tu as pris soin de toi, aujourd'hui...
russian:
С возвращением, [Ari]. Надеюсь, ты не слишком

утруждали

утруждалаутруждалутруждало своё тело сегодня...
bulgarian: [Ari], welcome home. I hope you weren't too rough on your body today...

english: And if it was uneventful, feel free to add as many outlandish embellishments as you'd like.
french: Et même s'il ne s'est pas passé grand-chose, n'hésite pas à inventer autant de détails extravagants que tu veux.
russian: А если день небогат на события, можешь приукрасить самыми невероятными подробностями.
bulgarian: And if it was uneventful, feel free to add as many outlandish embellishments as you'd like.

english: I always enjoy a good yarn.
french: J'aime bien qu'on enjolive les histoires.
russian: Я люблю нелепые россказни.
bulgarian: I always enjoy a good yarn.

english: How has your day been? Come on, I'll make some tea and you can tell me all about it.
french: Comment s'est passée ta journée ? Je vais préparer du thé, tu pourras tout me raconter.
russian: Как прошёл твой день? Давай я заварю чай, и ты мне всё расскажешь.
bulgarian: How has your day been? Come on, I'll make some tea and you can tell me all about it.

english: It's a dream to have you and our wonderful home to return to...
french: C'est un rêve de savoir que je vous retrouverai, toi et notre doux foyer, chaque soir...
russian: Возвращаться домой и видеть там тебя — это лучшее чувство на свете...
bulgarian: It's a dream to have you and our wonderful home to return to...

english: Thank you for sharing this with me, [Ari]. I adore you.
french: Merci de partager ça avec moi, [Ari]. Je t'aime tellement.
russian:
Спасибо, что

открыли

открылаоткрылоткрыло его для меня, [Ari]. Я тебя обожаю.
bulgarian: Thank you for sharing this with me, [Ari]. I adore you.

english: I was thinking about you all day.
french: J'ai pensé à toi toute la journée.
russian: Я весь день про тебя думала.
bulgarian: I was thinking about you all day.

english: But I'm relieved that you always seem healthy as a horse.
french: En revanche, je suis soulagée de constater que tu as toujours une santé de fer.
russian:
Меня успокаивает, что ты, кажется, всегда

здоровы

здороваздоровздорово как бык.
bulgarian: But I'm relieved that you always seem healthy as a horse.

english: In fact, now that I'm living on a farm, I can confidently say you're healthier than most horses.
french: D'ailleurs, maintenant que je vois ta vie au quotidien, je peux même affirmer que tu as une santé de « ferme » !
russian: Поскольку я живу на ферме, теперь я могу ответственно заявить, что ты даже здоровее многих быков.
bulgarian: In fact, now that I'm living on a farm, I can confidently say you're healthier than most horses.

english: I always get a bit anxious when the flu season comes around...
french: Lorsque la saison de la grippe arrive, je me sens angoissée.
russian: Когда начинается простудный сезон, я всегда начинаю нервничать...
bulgarian: I always get a bit anxious when the flu season comes around...

english: Would you like to join me? I'll read one to you, and we can be melancholy together.
french: Ça te dit ? Je t'en lirai une pendant que tu me serreras dans tes bras, comme ça, nous partagerons ensemble cette mélancolie.
russian: Хочешь составить мне компанию? Я почитаю тебе вслух, а ты будешь меня обнимать. Предадимся печали вместе.
bulgarian: Would you like to join me? I'll read one to you, and we can be melancholy together.

english: In honor of the season, I've borrowed a collection of ghost stories from Elsie. She's assured me they're all terribly melancholy.
french: Puisque c'est de saison, j'ai emprunté un recueil d'histoires de fantômes à Elsie. Elle m'a assuré qu'elles étaient toutes très mélancoliques.
russian: Под стать сезону, я одолжила у Элси сборник рассказов о привидениях. Она уверяет, что они все ужасно печальные.
bulgarian: In honor of the season, I've borrowed a collection of ghost stories from Elsie. She's assured me they're all terribly melancholy.

english: But the wellbeing of the town calls.
french: Mais le bien-être des gens de la ville m'appelle.
russian: Но мой долг — следить за здоровьем горожан.
bulgarian: But the wellbeing of the town calls.

english: I'd better head off to the Clinic soon.
french: Profite au mieux de ta journée, [Ari].
russian: Хорошего дня, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'd better head off to the Clinic soon.

english: I do wish I could stay here and enjoy the autumn colors with you...
french: J'aimerais pouvoir rester à la ferme pour que nous profitions ensemble des couleurs automnales...
russian: Я бы очень хотела остаться на ферме и вместе с тобой любоваться красками осени...
bulgarian: I do wish I could stay here and enjoy the autumn colors with you...

english: I do hope you'll join me. We'll be celebrating every day.
french: J'espère que tu te joindras à moi. Nous célébrerons chaque jour comme il se doit.
russian: Я надеюсь, ты разделишь его со мной. Будем праздновать каждый день.
bulgarian: I do hope you'll join me. We'll be celebrating every day.

english: Finally, we've come to my favorite time of year... the season of hot drinks.
french: Voilà enfin la période de l'année que je préfère : la saison des boissons chaudes.
russian: Наконец-то наступило моё любимое время года... Сезон горячих напитков.
bulgarian: Finally, we've come to my favorite time of year... the season of hot drinks.

english: But waking up next to you does make me reconsider.
french: Toutefois, quand je me réveille à tes côtés, c'est une autre histoire.
russian: Но когда я просыпаюсь рядом с тобой, начинаю сомневаться.
bulgarian: But waking up next to you does make me reconsider.

english: Lounging in bed with you is vastly preferable to an early start.
french: Traîner au lit avec toi est bien plus agréable que de commencer ma journée de bonne heure.
russian: Поваляться вместе кровати гораздо приятнее, чем с утра браться за работу.
bulgarian: Lounging in bed with you is vastly preferable to an early start.

english: I normally consider myself an early riser...
french: Je suis plutôt habituée à me lever tôt.
russian: Обычно я считаю себя жаворонком...
bulgarian: I normally consider myself an early riser...

english: If not... why don't we make a pot of =Coffee=? I picked up a new blend recently.
french: Et si ce n'est pas le cas, que dirais-tu d'un bon =café= ? J'ai acheté un nouveau mélange, il n'y a pas longtemps.
russian: Если нет, то... почему бы нам не заварить =кофе= на двоих? Я недавно купила новую смесь.
bulgarian: If not... why don't we make a pot of =Coffee=? I picked up a new blend recently.

english: Good morning, dearest. I do hope you slept well.
french: Bonjour, mon amour. J'espère que tu as bien dormi.
russian:
Доброе утро,

мои дорогие

моя дорогаямой дорогоймоё дорогое. Тебе хорошо спалось?
bulgarian: Good morning, dearest. I do hope you slept well.

english: Somehow, the sound of the rain is even more peaceful here on the farm.
french: Et le bruit de la pluie est encore plus paisible ici, à la ferme.
russian: Почему-то шум дождя у нам на ферме ещё более успокаивает.
bulgarian: Somehow, the sound of the rain is even more peaceful here on the farm.

english: I do always love a quiet rainy day.
french: J'aime le calme des journées pluvieuses.
russian: Мне нравятся тихие дождливые дни.
bulgarian: I do always love a quiet rainy day.

english: The farm looks enchanting, doesn't it? It's like something out of a storybook.
french: La ferme a un côté enchanteur, n'est-ce pas ? Elle semble tout droit sortie d'un conte.
russian: Ферма выглядит просто завораживающе. Будто в сказке, правда?
bulgarian: The farm looks enchanting, doesn't it? It's like something out of a storybook.

english: It's been raining all morning.
french: Il a plu toute la matinée.
russian: Дождь льёт всё утро.
bulgarian: It's been raining all morning.

english: I'm waiting for the =Coffee= to wake me up.
french: J'attends que le =café= fasse effet.
russian: Теперь я жду, когда подействует =кофе=.
bulgarian: I'm waiting for the =Coffee= to wake me up.

english: Though... perhaps a kiss would help more.
french: Même si un baiser serait plus efficace.
russian: Хотя... Возможно, поцелуй мне больше поможет?
bulgarian: Though... perhaps a kiss would help more.

english: It was too difficult getting out of bed this morning...
french: J'ai eu beaucoup de mal à sortir du lit, ce matin...
russian: Сегодня утром вылезать из постели особенно трудно...
bulgarian: It was too difficult getting out of bed this morning...

english: Let's make some warm drinks and watch it come down together.
french: Préparons des boissons chaudes et regardons-la tomber ensemble.
russian: Давай выпьем чего-нибудь горяченького и будем смотреть на снегопад.
bulgarian: Let's make some warm drinks and watch it come down together.

english: How is the snow looking outside?
french: Est-ce qu'il neige, dehors ?
russian: Как там снег на улице?
bulgarian: How is the snow looking outside?

english: I could never see such pristine snow while living over the Clinic. By closing time, it would mostly be trampled.
french: Quand je vivais à la clinique, je voyais rarement un manteau de neige aussi immaculée. À l'heure où je sortais, tout avait déjà été piétiné.
russian: Когда я жила возле клиники, я никогда не видела такого чистого снега. К концу дня он обычно весь истоптан.
bulgarian: I could never see such pristine snow while living over the Clinic. By closing time, it would mostly be trampled.

english: It's wonderful to share this with you.
french: C'est merveilleux de pouvoir partager ça avec toi.
russian: Любоваться этим видом вместе с тобой — замечательное чувство.
bulgarian: It's wonderful to share this with you.

english: The snowfall is rather beautiful, isn't it?
french: C'est très beau de regarder la neige tomber, hein ?
russian: Какой красивый снегопад, правда?
bulgarian: The snowfall is rather beautiful, isn't it?

english: If you'd like to stop by later... I wouldn't be against it.
french: Si tu veux passer me voir, je n'ai rien contre.
russian: Если хочешь, можешь сегодня зайти... Я буду не против.
bulgarian: If you'd like to stop by later... I wouldn't be against it.

english: Look at the time... I'll be off to the Clinic soon.
french: Regarde l'heure qu'il est ! Je vais devoir aller à la clinique.
russian: Мне пора идти... Скоро надо открывать клинику.
bulgarian: Look at the time... I'll be off to the Clinic soon.

english: Why don't we get under the blankets, and you can tell me all about your day.
french: Et si nous nous installions confortablement sous la couverture pour que tu me racontes ta journée ?
russian: Может, заберёмся под одеяло? Расскажешь, как прошёл твой день.
bulgarian: Why don't we get under the blankets, and you can tell me all about your day.

english: The evenings still have a wintery chill, don't they?
french: On sent encore un peu la fraîcheur de l'hiver, hein ?
russian: По вечерам ещё держится зимний мороз.
bulgarian: The evenings still have a wintery chill, don't they?

english: Josephine insisted I borrow her collection. Would you like me to read you something tonight?
french: Joséphine a insisté pour que j'emprunte un de ses recueils. Tu aimerais que je te lise un poème au lit, ce soir ?
russian: Джозефина одолжила мне свой сборник. Хочешь, я прочитаю тебе что-нибудь оттуда, пока мы лежим?
bulgarian: Josephine insisted I borrow her collection. Would you like me to read you something tonight?

english: Spring calls for poetry, doesn't it? Or so they say.
french: Le printemps est propice à la poésie, n'est-ce pas ? C'est en tout cas ce qu'on dit.
russian: Весна — время поэтов, правда? По-моему, так говорят.
bulgarian: Spring calls for poetry, doesn't it? Or so they say.

english: However...
french: Cependant...
russian: Есть одно «но».
bulgarian: However...

english: It's difficult to find peace when half the town comes into the Clinic with hayfever.
french: C'est difficile d'avoir la paix quand la moitié de la ville vient à la clinique avec un rhume des foins.
russian: Когда полгорода приходит в клинику с аллергией, трудно бывает расслабиться.
bulgarian: It's difficult to find peace when half the town comes into the Clinic with hayfever.

english: It's what I signed up for, I suppose.
french: Enfin, c'est ce pour quoi j'ai signé, j'imagine.
russian: Впрочем, я знала, на что иду.
bulgarian: It's what I signed up for, I suppose.

english: I do enjoy spring...
french: J'aime le printemps.
russian: Мне нравится весна, но...
bulgarian: I do enjoy spring...

english: Tell me if any of the cows have trouble. I know how to manage a challenging birth.
french: Si jamais une vache a du mal à vêler, préviens-moi. J'ai eu mon lot de naissances compliquées à gérer.
russian: Скажи, если с ними будут проблемы. Я знаю, как принимать трудные роды.
bulgarian: Tell me if any of the cows have trouble. I know how to manage a challenging birth.

english: The benefits of marrying a doctor.
french: Se marier avec un médecin a ses avantages.
russian: Хорошо, когда жена доктор, да?
bulgarian: The benefits of marrying a doctor.

english: Spring is calving season, isn't it?
french: C'est au printemps que les veaux viennent au monde, non ?
russian: Коровы обычно телятся весной, да ведь?
bulgarian: Spring is calving season, isn't it?

english: Obviously, this is an emergency. Time to break out the breezy linen sheets.
french: Cependant, c'est un cas d'urgence. Il est temps de sortir les draps en lin très légers.
russian: Очевидно, это экстренный случай. Пора доставать самые лёгкие простыни.
bulgarian: Obviously, this is an emergency. Time to break out the breezy linen sheets.

english: I like when we get to relax in bed in the evening, but this summer heat...
french: J'aimerais pouvoir te serrer dans mes bras, au lit, mais quelle chaleur !
russian: Я бы хотела лечь в постель и обнять тебя покрепче, но в такую жару...
bulgarian: I like when we get to relax in bed in the evening, but this summer heat...

english: I do appreciate that cool summer breeze after a long hot day.

russian: Люблю прохладный ветерок после долгого дня на жаре.
bulgarian: I do appreciate that cool summer breeze after a long hot day.

english: It's so lovely on the farm after the sun sets...
french: La ferme est si agréable après le coucher du soleil...
russian: Как хорошо на ферме, когда зайдёт солнце...
bulgarian: It's so lovely on the farm after the sun sets...

english: Hm...
french: Mmm...
russian: Хм...
bulgarian: Hm...

english: I hope fewer people will come in to the Clinic overheated today.
french: J'espère que personne ne viendra à la clinique avec une insolation, aujourd'hui.
russian: Надеюсь, сегодня ко мне никто не пожалует с солнечным ударом.
bulgarian: I hope fewer people will come in to the Clinic overheated today.

bulgarian: Another beautiful summer morning.

russian: Иди сюда. Давай согреем друг друга.
bulgarian: Come here. Let's warm each other up.

english: The winter nights get so chilly now...
french: Les nuits d'hiver deviennent frisquettes...
russian: Зимние ночи сейчас такие холодные...
bulgarian: The winter nights get so chilly now...

english: Quiet like this used to be a bit daunting.
french: Avant, un tel silence m'angoissait.
russian: Раньше мне от такой тишины становилось жутко.
bulgarian: Quiet like this used to be a bit daunting.

english: But out here on the farm, with you... it all feels rather tranquil.
french: Mais ici, à la ferme avec toi, je trouve cela apaisant.
russian: А здесь с тобой, на ферме... Я чувствую умиротворение.
bulgarian: But out here on the farm, with you... it all feels rather tranquil.

english: Nights are so quiet in the winter...
french: Les nuits sont si calmes, l'hiver...
russian: Зимой по ночам так тихо...
bulgarian: Nights are so quiet in the winter...

english: Especially considering my charming company.
french: Surtout parce que je suis en si charmante compagnie.
russian: Тем более в такой очаровательной компании.
bulgarian: Especially considering my charming company.

english: The cold weather does make it especially difficult to get out of bed...
french: Il est particulièrement difficile de sortir du lit, par ce temps glacial...
russian: В холодную погоду особенно трудно вылезать из постели...
bulgarian: The cold weather does make it especially difficult to get out of bed...

english: If anything's amiss, come visit me at the Clinic. Whatever you need, I'll take care of you.
french: Si jamais tu ne te sens pas bien, passe me voir à la clinique. Quoi qu'il puisse t'arriver, je m'occuperai bien de toi.
russian: Если почувствуешь себя неважно, заходи ко мне в клинику. Я дам тебе всё, что нужно.
bulgarian: If anything's amiss, come visit me at the Clinic. Whatever you need, I'll take care of you.

english: It looks chilly out there. Are you bundled properly for the day?
french: Il a l'air de faire froid, dehors. Tu es suffisamment couvert<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> pour la journée ?
russian:
На дворе мороз. Ты хорошо

укутались

укуталасьукуталсяукуталось на сегодня?
bulgarian: It looks chilly out there. Are you bundled properly for the day?

english: Keeping patient files up-to-date is one of the most important parts of clinic work... unfortunately, it's also the most tedious.
french: Tenir les dossiers médicaux des patients à jour représente une part très importante de mon travail à la clinique. C'est aussi l'une des plus ennuyeuses.
russian: Поддерживать актуальность медицинских карточек — одна из важнейших задач в работе клиники... И, у несчастью, одна из скучнейших.
bulgarian: Keeping patient files up-to-date is one of the most important parts of clinic work... unfortunately, it's also the most tedious.

english: Just getting caught up on my clinical notes.
french: Je suis en train de passer mes notes en revue.
russian: Сижу дорабатываю медицинские журналы.
bulgarian: Just getting caught up on my clinical notes.

english: It's all terribly dry. I'll be done soon.
french: C'est terriblement fastidieux. J'aurai bientôt fini.
russian: Ужасно строгий стиль письма. Я скоро закончу.
bulgarian: It's all terribly dry. I'll be done soon.

english: Ah, [Ari]. I'm writing to a colleague to ask after some clinical trial results.
french: Ah, [Ari]. J'écris à un collègue pour obtenir les résultats de certains essais cliniques.
russian: А, [Ari]. Я сочиняю письмо коллеге. Хочу узнать результаты последних клинических испытаний.
bulgarian: Ah, [Ari]. I'm writing to a colleague to ask after some clinical trial results.

english: Don't worry, I'll persevere. But keep me in your thoughts, will you?
french: Ne t'en fais pas, je persévère. Mais pense à moi, d'accord ?
russian: Не волнуйся, я справлюсь. Не забывай про меня, ладно?
bulgarian: Don't worry, I'll persevere. But keep me in your thoughts, will you?

english: The paperwork never ends, does it?
french: Je n'en finis jamais de toute cette paperasse !
russian: Бумажная работа никогда не кончается.
bulgarian: The paperwork never ends, does it?

english: This one is a real pageturner, and they're about to reveal the killer's identity...
french: Ce livre me tient vraiment en haleine et ils sont sur le point de révéler l'identité de l'assassin...
russian: Очень увлекательное чтиво. И вот-вот расскажут, кто убийца...
bulgarian: This one is a real pageturner, and they're about to reveal the killer's identity...

english: I'll be with you in a moment, [Ari]...
french: Donne-moi juste un moment, [Ari]...
russian: Я скоро приду к тебе, [Ari]...
bulgarian: I'll be with you in a moment, [Ari]...

english: I'm trying to lose myself in the fiction of it all, but the prose keeps breaking my suspension of disbelief.
french: J'essaie de me concentrer sur l'histoire, mais ces erreurs m'empêchent de rentrer dans le récit.
russian: Я хочу прочувствовать произведение как следует, но эти мелочи портят мне погружение.
bulgarian: I'm trying to lose myself in the fiction of it all, but the prose keeps breaking my suspension of disbelief.

english: For one, if someone were to transform into a werewolf, their knees would not bend backward. That is absurd... and also incorrect.
french: Déjà, si quelqu'un se transformait en loup-garou, ses genoux ne se plieraient pas à l'envers. C'est absurde et complètement faux.
russian: К примеру, если человек превратится в оборотня, коленки не будут выгибаться назад. Это просто нелепо... И совершенно неправдоподобно.
bulgarian: For one, if someone were to transform into a werewolf, their knees would not bend backward. That is absurd... and also incorrect.

english: Is it gauche to write a publisher when a novel gets medical details wrong?
french: Ce serait maladroit d'écrire à un éditeur pour signaler que tous les passages médicaux sont faux dans son roman ?
russian: Как ты считаешь, бестактно будет написать издателю, что автор ошибся в медицинских подробностях?
bulgarian: Is it gauche to write a publisher when a novel gets medical details wrong?

english: And they do put ideas in your head...
french: Et elles donnent plein d'idées...
russian: После них в голову приходят всякие мысли...
bulgarian: And they do put ideas in your head...

english: I can't say that I'm fully aligned with Elsie's taste in romance books, but she certainly never reads anything dull.
french: Je dois admettre que je ne partage pas les goûts d'Elsie pour les romans à l'eau de rose, mais ses lectures n'ont jamais l'air soporifiques.
russian: Не скажу, что я полностью разделяю вкус Элси в части романтических произведений. Но скучных вещей она определённо не читает.
bulgarian: I can't say that I'm fully aligned with Elsie's taste in romance books, but she certainly never reads anything dull.

english: They're fairly concentrated at this stage, and haven't been flavored yet.
french: À ce stage, ils sont encore très concentrés et n'ont pas été aromatisés.
russian: На данном этапе они очень концентрированные и без вкусовых добавок.
bulgarian: They're fairly concentrated at this stage, and haven't been flavored yet.

english: So no sampling, unless you'd like an upset stomach.
french: Je ne t'y ferai pas goûter sauf si tu veux avoir mal à l'estomac.
russian: Так что лучше не пробуй, не то заработаешь несварение желудка.
bulgarian: So no sampling, unless you'd like an upset stomach.

english: I'm in the middle of distilling a new batch of syrups to replenish the Clinic's inventory.
french: Je suis en train de distiller une nouvelle fournée de sirops pour refaire les réserves de la clinique.
russian: Я занимаюсь очисткой новой партии сиропов, чтобы пополнить запасы в клинике.
bulgarian: I'm in the middle of distilling a new batch of syrups to replenish the Clinic's inventory.

english: But they're still poisonous. So do be careful around my station.
french: En revanche, elles n'en demeurent pas moins toxiques. Fais bien attention autour de mon plan de travail.
russian:
Но они всё ещё ядовиты. Так что будь

осторожны

осторожнаостороженосторожно, когда ходишь у моего рабочего стола.
bulgarian: But they're still poisonous. So do be careful around my station.

english: Some toxins, given the correct preparation and dosage, can become powerful medicines.
french: Certaines toxines, si elles sont correctement préparées et bien dosées, peuvent faire des remèdes très efficaces.
russian: Из некоторых токсинов при правильно обработке и дозировке можно сделать отличные лекарства.
bulgarian: Some toxins, given the correct preparation and dosage, can become powerful medicines.

english: Just distilling some water.
french: Je suis juste en train de distiller de l'eau.
russian: Просто дистиллирую воду.
bulgarian: Just distilling some water.

english: Did you expect some mad science?
french: Tu t'attendais à des expériences scientifiques interdites ?
russian: А что, думаешь, я безумный учёный?
bulgarian: Did you expect some mad science?

english: What am I doing, you ask?
french: Tu veux savoir ce que je fais ?
russian: Хочешь знать, что я делаю?
bulgarian: What am I doing, you ask?

english: I'm not one of the judges, but I'm certain our animals will take home a prize!
bulgarian: I'm not one of the judges, but I'm certain our animals will take home a prize!

english: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you excited for the $Animal Festival$?
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you excited for the $Animal Festival$?

english: Once you've sampled all the delicacies at the feast, do find me...
bulgarian: Once you've sampled all the delicacies at the feast, do find me...

english: I'd love to join you for the dance.
bulgarian: I'd love to join you for the dance.

english: Good morning and happy $Harvest Festival$!
bulgarian: Good morning and happy $Harvest Festival$!

english: We can watch the stars from anywhere... but the Summit has the best view of all, don't you think?
bulgarian: We can watch the stars from anywhere... but the Summit has the best view of all, don't you think?

english: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you excited for tonight's $Shooting Star Festival$?
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you excited for tonight's $Shooting Star Festival$?

english: I haven't had the time to pick any $Breath of Spring$ this year...
bulgarian: I haven't had the time to pick any $Breath of Spring$ this year...

english: But I'll be cheering for you!
bulgarian: But I'll be cheering for you!

english: Goodness, is it the $Spring Festival$ already? How time flies.
bulgarian: Goodness, is it the $Spring Festival$ already? How time flies.

english: Perhaps I'll stop by Darcy's booth and ask her to make me another devious espresso creation.
bulgarian: Perhaps I'll stop by Darcy's booth and ask her to make me another devious espresso creation.

english: Ah, wonderful. It's the Saturday Market again.
bulgarian: Ah, wonderful. It's the Saturday Market again.

english: I'm excited to see what Louis has devised since I saw him last. He does use lovely materials
bulgarian: I'm excited to see what Louis has devised since I saw him last. He does use lovely materials

english: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you looking forward to the Saturday Market?
bulgarian: Good morning, [Ari]. Are you looking forward to the Saturday Market?

english: I'm curious to stop by Merri's shop... she always has the least expected antiques. It's fun to window shop.
bulgarian: I'm curious to stop by Merri's shop... she always has the least expected antiques. It's fun to window shop.

english: The Saturday Market is here again. Are you thinking of stopping by?
bulgarian: The Saturday Market is here again. Are you thinking of stopping by?

english: Are you thinking of going to the Saturday Market today? If you do, would you mind checking in on Stillwell for me?
bulgarian: Are you thinking of going to the Saturday Market today? If you do, would you mind checking in on Stillwell for me?

english: I know his type... he probably hasn't seen a doctor in ages.
bulgarian: I know his type... he probably hasn't seen a doctor in ages.

english: [Ari], good morning.
bulgarian: [Ari], good morning.

english: I feel obligated to make sure that fellow is regulating his stress properly.
bulgarian: I feel obligated to make sure that fellow is regulating his stress properly.

english: I'm thinking about wandering around the Saturday Market today, perhaps to stop by Taliferro's booth.
bulgarian: I'm thinking about wandering around the Saturday Market today, perhaps to stop by Taliferro's booth.

english: I was thinking about getting a trim at Vera's today.
bulgarian: I was thinking about getting a trim at Vera's today.

english: It's Saturday again... are you planning on going to the Market?
bulgarian: It's Saturday again... are you planning on going to the Market?

english: I know it's the Saturday Market, but I do hope you're not planning on going to Wheedle's booth.
bulgarian: I know it's the Saturday Market, but I do hope you're not planning on going to Wheedle's booth.

english: His wares seem to be of decent quality, but I can't say the same of the man himself.
bulgarian: His wares seem to be of decent quality, but I can't say the same of the man himself.

english: Ah, good morning, [Ari].
bulgarian: Ah, good morning, [Ari].

english: If you happen to stop by the Market, I wouldn't mind something new from Zorel...
bulgarian: If you happen to stop by the Market, I wouldn't mind something new from Zorel...

english: Listening to music at home is always relaxing.
bulgarian: Listening to music at home is always relaxing.

english: Ah, good morning.
bulgarian: Ah, good morning.

english: I've called Mistria home my entire life, and never had a strong desire to leave. Even when I went to university, I knew I would return.
french: Je me suis toujours sentie chez moi, à Mistria. Je n'ai jamais eu envie d'en partir. Même quand je suis allée à l'université, je savais que je reviendrais.
russian: Я всю жизнь называла Мистрию своим домом и никогда не хотела уезжать. Даже когда я поступила в университет, я знала, что вернусь сюда.
bulgarian: I've called Mistria home my entire life, and never had a strong desire to leave. Even when I went to university, I knew I would return.

english: Ah. I was hoping there was a chance you would have forgiven me for that incident. You did marry me, after all.
french: Ah, j'espérais que tu m'avais pardonné ce malheureux incident. Après tout, tu m'as épousée.
russian:
Эх. Я надеялась, что ты

успели

успелауспелуспело простить мне тот неприятный случай. Всё-таки мы теперь супруги.
bulgarian: Ah. I was hoping there was a chance you would have forgiven me for that incident. You did marry me, after all.

english: I promise I will neither poison you nor drop any large stones on your head.
french: Je te promets que je ne t'empoisonnerai pas et qu'aucune grosse pierre ne te tombera sur la tête.
russian: Я обещаю не травить тебя и не сбрасывать на голову огромных камней.
bulgarian: I promise I will neither poison you nor drop any large stones on your head.

english: And if I find you either poisoned or concussed, I also promise to nurse you back to perfect health.
french: Et en cas d'empoisonnement ou de traumatisme crânien, je te jure également de m'occuper de toi et de te guérir.
russian: А если обнаружу у тебя отравление или сотрясение, то обещаю тебя выходить.
bulgarian: And if I find you either poisoned or concussed, I also promise to nurse you back to perfect health.

english: I love you, [Ari]. I'll make it my life's goal to spoil you rotten from now on.
french: Je t'aime, [Ari]. Le but de ma vie sera désormais de te combler.
russian: Я люблю тебя, [Ari]. Отныне моя цель в жизни — лелеять тебя сверх всякой меры.
bulgarian: I love you, [Ari]. I'll make it my life's goal to spoil you rotten from now on.

english: Then the earthquake happened, and it strengthened my resolve to stay even more. I was needed by the people who remained.
french: Puis il y a eu le tremblement de terre et cela n'a fait que renforcer ma volonté de rester. Les gens d'ici avaient besoin de moi.
russian: А затем землетрясение ещё больше укрепило моё желание остаться. Во мне нуждались те, кто решил не уезжать.
bulgarian: Then the earthquake happened, and it strengthened my resolve to stay even more. I was needed by the people who remained.

english: But I knew if I stayed here, I would likely never get married. I had no expectation that I could have hearth as well as home.
french: Mais je savais qu'en restant, je ne me marierais probablement jamais. Je ne pensais pas fonder un foyer ici.
russian: Но я понимала, что, оставшись здесь, я вряд ли смогу вступить в брак. И отказалась от ожиданий семейного счастья.
bulgarian: But I knew if I stayed here, I would likely never get married. I had no expectation that I could have hearth as well as home.

english: Then, a spring breeze delivered you to me.
french: Puis une douce brise printanière t'a alors porté<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> jusqu'à moi.
russian:
И вот на крыльях весеннего ветра ко мне

явились

явиласьявилсяявилось ты.
bulgarian: Then, a spring breeze delivered you to me.

english: I feel utterly spoiled that I get to share my life here with you.
french: Je me sens comblée de pouvoir partager ma vie ici, avec toi.
russian: Провести жизнь здесь вместе с тобой — для меня это подарок судьбы.
bulgarian: I feel utterly spoiled that I get to share my life here with you.

english: Together, we can have it all!
french: Ensemble, nous ne manquerons de rien !
russian: Давай возьмём от жизни всё!
bulgarian: Together, we can have it all!

english: Just as long as there are no more perilous experiments!
french: En revanche, il n'y aura plus d'expériences dangereuses !
russian: Только давай больше без смертельно опасных экспериментов!
bulgarian: Just as long as there are no more perilous experiments!

english: We can, can't we?
french: C'est bien vrai, hein ?
russian: И правда, вы ведь можем себе это позволить!
bulgarian: We can, can't we?

english: I was taught to think of life as a series of compromises...
french: On m'a toujours appris à penser que la vie n'était faite que de compromis.
russian: Меня учили, что жизнь — это череда компромиссов...
bulgarian: I was taught to think of life as a series of compromises...

english: But in the end, all I needed was some patience and things worked out beautifully.
french: Mais finalement, il a juste fallu que je fasse preuve d'un peu de patience, et tout s'est déroulé à merveille.
russian: Но в конце концов оказалось, что надо лишь запастись терпением, и всё сложится само собой.
bulgarian: But in the end, all I needed was some patience and things worked out beautifully.

english: I love you, [Ari]. I'll make it my life's goal to spoil you rotten.
french: Je t'aime, [Ari]. Le but de ma vie sera désormais de te combler.
russian: Я люблю тебя, [Ari]. Отныне моя цель в жизни — лелеять тебя сверх всякой меры.
bulgarian: I love you, [Ari]. I'll make it my life's goal to spoil you rotten.

english: But now look at it! What a transformation.
french: Mais regarde-la maintenant ! Quelle métamorphose !
russian: А теперь она так преобразилась! Просто заглядение!
bulgarian: But now look at it! What a transformation.

english: I'm not one for magical turns of phrase, but everything you touch does seem to turn to gold, [Ari].
french: Je ne suis pas du genre à employer des expressions fantasmagoriques, mais tout ce que tu touches se transforme en or, [Ari].
russian: Я редко прибегаю к магическим оборотам, но кажется, всё, чего ты касаешься, превращается в золото, [Ari].
bulgarian: I'm not one for magical turns of phrase, but everything you touch does seem to turn to gold, [Ari].

english: I suspect that you'll continue to change me for the better, too.
french: Je crois que, grâce à toi, je n'aurai de cesse de m'améliorer.
russian: Вероятно, и я буду становиться лучше под твоим влиянием.
bulgarian: I suspect that you'll continue to change me for the better, too.

english: In all my time living in Mistria, I was never able to explore this farmland. It was too overgrown with brambles to properly admire.
french: De toute ma vie à Mistria, je n'avais jamais exploré cette ferme. Elle était trop envahie par la végétation pour qu'on puisse en profiter.
russian: За всё время, что я живу в Мистрии, мне не доводилось случая обследовать эту местность. Тут было слишком много зарослей, чтобы оценить её красоту.
bulgarian: In all my time living in Mistria, I was never able to explore this farmland. It was too overgrown with brambles to properly admire.

english: You have a smudge on your face. Here, let me.
french: Tu as le visage taché. Là, laisse-moi...
russian: У тебя что-то на лице. Дай-ка сюда.
bulgarian: You have a smudge on your face. Here, let me.

english: There. You look perfectly sparkling.
french: Voilà. Tu es parfaitement propre.
russian: Вот так. Теперь можешь блистать.
bulgarian: There. You look perfectly sparkling.

english: Are you flirting with me?
french: Tu es en train d'essayer de me séduire ?
russian: Ты что, флиртуешь со мной?
bulgarian: Are you flirting with me?

english: Are you angling for a kiss?
french: C'est un baiser que tu veux ?
russian: Это заход на поцелуй?
bulgarian: Are you angling for a kiss?

english: Certainly not.
french: Absolument pas.
russian: Вовсе нет.
bulgarian: Certainly not.

english: It's not in my nature to be coy. You'll know when I'm flirting with you.
french: Il n'est pas dans ma nature d'être faussement pudique. Si je veux te séduire, tu le sauras vite.
russian: Иносказания не в моём вкусе. Ты заметишь, когда я буду флиртовать.
bulgarian: It's not in my nature to be coy. You'll know when I'm flirting with you.

english: We are married. If I wish to flirt with you, I will be quite forward about it.
french: Nous sommes en couple. Si je veux te séduire, je n'irai pas par quatre chemins.
russian: Мы же супруги. Если мне захочется с тобой пофлиртовать, я не стану этого скрывать.
bulgarian: We are married. If I wish to flirt with you, I will be quite forward about it.

english: Certainly not.
french: Absolument pas.
russian: Вовсе нет.
bulgarian: Certainly not.

english: It's not in my nature to be coy. You'll know when I wish to kiss you.
french: Il n'est pas dans ma nature d'être faussement pudique. Si je cherche à t'embrasser, tu le sauras vite.
russian: Иносказания не в моём вкусе. Ты заметишь, когда я захочу тебя поцеловать.
bulgarian: It's not in my nature to be coy. You'll know when I wish to kiss you.

english: We are married. If I wish to kiss you, I will be quite forward about it.
french: Nous sommes en couple. Si je veux t'embrasser, je n'irai pas par quatre chemins.
russian: Мы же супруги. Если мне захочется поцеловать тебя, я не стану этого скрывать.
bulgarian: We are married. If I wish to kiss you, I will be quite forward about it.

english: [Ari], come here for a moment.
french: [Ari], approche, juste un instant.
russian: [Ari], подойди на минутку.
bulgarian: [Ari], come here for a moment.

english: And I do take great pride in my work. However...
french: Et mon travail me rend très fière. Toutefois...
russian: И я горжусь тем, что делаю. И всё же...
bulgarian: And I do take great pride in my work. However...

english: Or maybe, exactly as many as you'd expect.
french: Ou peut-être autant que ce que tu crois.
russian: Хотя, возможно, ты как раз представляешь.
bulgarian: Or maybe, exactly as many as you'd expect.

english: Unfortunately, I'm not much for invertebrate care.
french: Malheureusement, je ne suis pas experte dans les soins à prodiguer aux invertébrés.
russian: Увы, я не специалист по уходу за беспозвоночными.
bulgarian: Unfortunately, I'm not much for invertebrate care.

english: Perhaps I went into the wrong line of work?
french: Et si je m'étais trompée de carrière ?
russian: Может, где-то в карьерном пути я свернула не туда?
bulgarian: Perhaps I went into the wrong line of work?

english: It's admittedly difficult when the children of the town bring me strange creatures to "help." Many of which do not in fact need any intervention.
french: Ça se complique quand les enfants de Mistria m'apportent toutes sortes de créatures pour les « aider » et qui, pour la plupart, n'ont besoin d'aucune intervention.
russian: Должна признать, что мне приходится тяжко, когда дети приносят мне всяких тварей и просят помочь. Многим из них вовсе не требуется медицинское вмешательство.
bulgarian: It's admittedly difficult when the children of the town bring me strange creatures to "help." Many of which do not in fact need any intervention.

english: I can do basic care for some barnyard animals, but I can't do much for, say, frogs and insects.
french: Je peux prodiguer des soins basiques aux animaux de la ferme, mais mes compétences sont limitées quand il s'agit de grenouilles ou d'insectes.
russian: Я могу оказать базовый уход за домашним скотом, но помочь лягушкам или, например, насекомым я бессильна.
bulgarian: I can do basic care for some barnyard animals, but I can't do much for, say, frogs and insects.

english: The kids bring you frogs?
french: Les enfants t'apportent des grenouilles ?
russian: Ребята приносят тебе лягушек?
bulgarian: The kids bring you frogs?

english: The kids bring you bugs?
french: Les enfants t'apportent des insectes ?
russian: Ребята приносят тебе жуков?
bulgarian: The kids bring you bugs?

english: Yes, well.
french: Oui, ça arrive.
russian: Ну да.
bulgarian: Yes, well.

english: Maple did recently bring me a frog that "wasn't working properly."
french: Il n'y a pas longtemps, Maple m'a apporté une grenouille qui, selon elle, ne « fonctionnait pas bien ».
russian: Мэйпл недавно принесла лягушку, которая «не работает как надо».
bulgarian: Maple did recently bring me a frog that "wasn't working properly."

english: Meaning, of course, it didn't magically turn her into a princess upon receiving a kiss.
french: Ce qui signifie, bien évidemment, qu'elle ne s'est pas transformée en princesse lorsque la grenouille l'a embrassée.
russian: Имея в виду, конечно, что она не превратила её в принцессу при поцелуе.
bulgarian: Meaning, of course, it didn't magically turn her into a princess upon receiving a kiss.

english: But don't worry. She wasn't much deterred.
french: Mais ne t'inquiète pas. Ça ne l'a pas découragée.
russian: Но ты за неё не переживай. Мэйпл это едва ли остановило.
bulgarian: But don't worry. She wasn't much deterred.

english: I assume she'll eventually gain her crown through more... clandestine means.
french: Je ne serais pas étonnée qu'elle obtienne sa couronne par des moyens un peu plus détournés.
russian: Я предполагаю, что рано или поздно она доберётся до короны... не столь прямым путём.
bulgarian: I assume she'll eventually gain her crown through more... clandestine means.

english: Hah! More than you'd expect.
french: Ha ! Plus que ce que tu crois.
russian: Ха! Больше, чем ты можешь представить.
bulgarian: Hah! More than you'd expect.

english: You know [Ari], I'd like to think I'm good at my job.
french: Tu sais, [Ari], j'aime à croire que je suis douée dans ce que je fais.
russian: Знаешь, [Ari], мне нравится считать, что я хорошо делаю свою работу.
bulgarian: You know [Ari], I'd like to think I'm good at my job.

english: They separated when I was fairly young, but kept a cordial relationship. Neither remarried.
french: Ils se sont séparés quand j'étais encore assez jeune, mais ils se sont toujours bien entendus. Aucun ne s'est jamais remarié.
russian: Они разошлись, когда я была довольно маленькая, но поддерживали тёплые отношения. В повторный брак не вступали.
bulgarian: They separated when I was fairly young, but kept a cordial relationship. Neither remarried.

english: I don't think romance was especially important to either of them. And I thought I could live my life that way, too...
french: Je crois qu'aucun des deux n'était vraiment intéressé par l'amour. Et je pensais moi aussi pouvoir vivre ainsi...
russian: Мне кажется, их обоих не очень волновали сердечные дела. Я думала, что сама проживу такую же жизнь...
bulgarian: I don't think romance was especially important to either of them. And I thought I could live my life that way, too...

english: But [Ari], meeting you... it became apparent that I do crave romance in my life. And passion.
french: Mais [Ari], quand je t'ai rencontré<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they>, l'évidence m'a sauté aux yeux. J'avais besoin d'amour dans ma vie. Et de passion.
russian: Но когда встретила тебя, [Ari]... Мне стало ясно, что я жажду романтики. И страсти.
bulgarian: But [Ari], meeting you... it became apparent that I do crave romance in my life. And passion.

english: Marrying you has been a rousing adventure.
french: Me marier avec toi est une aventure qui a éveillé tous mes sens.
russian: Вступив в брак с тобой, я как будто начала вдохновляющее путешествие.
bulgarian: Marrying you has been a rousing adventure.

english: Lately, I've been thinking back on my parents' marriage.
french: Ces derniers temps, je repense au mariage de mes parents.
russian: В последнее время я часто вспоминаю про отношения моих родителей.
bulgarian: Lately, I've been thinking back on my parents' marriage.

english: I hope it doesn't bother you when I use a beaker or flask as a drinking vessel.
french: J'espère que ça ne te dérange pas que j'utilise un bocal ou un tube à essai pour boire.
russian: Ты не переживаешь, что я временами пью из колбы или пробирки?
bulgarian: I hope it doesn't bother you when I use a beaker or flask as a drinking vessel.

english: Sometimes, when I am deep in my research and find myself parched, I simply reach for whatever is at hand.
french: Parfois, quand je suis plongée dans mes recherches et que j'ai soif, je prends juste le premier récipient qui me tombe sous la main.
russian: Иногда я глубоко погружена в работу и не хочу отвлекаться. Поэтому беру первую ёмкость, что попадётся под руку...
bulgarian: Sometimes, when I am deep in my research and find myself parched, I simply reach for whatever is at hand.

english: As long as you're not drinking chemicals...
french: Tant que tu ne bois pas de produits chimiques...
russian: Главное, что ты не пьёшь свои химикаты...
bulgarian: As long as you're not drinking chemicals...

english: It looks kind of fun...
french: Ça a l'air plutôt marrant...
russian: Со стороны выглядит занимательно...
bulgarian: It looks kind of fun...

english: Only the fun ones. Now that we're married, I can share with you.
french: Seulement ceux qui ont les effets les plus drôles. Maintenant que nous sommes ensemble, je peux te le dire.
russian: Только самые весёлые. Мы женаты, так что больше незачем скрывать.
bulgarian: Only the fun ones. Now that we're married, I can share with you.

english: Kidding, of course. I stick to water.
french: Je rigole, évidemment. Je me contente de boire de l'eau.
russian: Шучу, шучу. Я пью только воду.
bulgarian: Kidding, of course. I stick to water.

english: And wine. Occasionally.
french: Et du vin, à l'occasion.
russian: И вино. Время от времени.
bulgarian: And wine. Occasionally.

english: I suppose it is novel.
french: C'est vrai que ce n'est pas courant.
russian: Думаю, просто непривычно.
bulgarian: I suppose it is novel.

english: You know... I've always wanted to raise a champagne toast in graduated cylinders.
french: Tu sais, j'ai toujours voulu trinquer au champagne dans une éprouvette.
russian: Знаешь... Я всегда хотела поднять тост шампанским в мерном цилиндре.
bulgarian: You know... I've always wanted to raise a champagne toast in graduated cylinders.

english: Let's do that next time we have something to celebrate.
french: Nous devrions essayer, la prochaine fois que nous aurons quelque chose à fêter.
russian: Давай попробуем в следующий раз, когда будет что отмечать.
bulgarian: Let's do that next time we have something to celebrate.

english: [Ari]... It's only just occurred to me to ask...
french: [Ari], une chose vient de me traverser l'esprit, je tenais à te demander...
russian: [Ari]... Мне только сейчас пришло в голову спросить...
bulgarian: [Ari]... It's only just occurred to me to ask...

english: She was worried I'd become complacent in my solitude...
french: Elle s'inquiétait pour moi. Elle trouvait que je me complaisais de plus en plus dans ma solitude...
russian: Она переживала, что я перестану искать выход из одиночества...
bulgarian: She was worried I'd become complacent in my solitude...

english: I suppose I had.
french: Ce qui était peut-être un peu le cas.
russian: Да я и перестала.
bulgarian: I suppose I had.

english: But you shook me out of that, didn't you?
french: Mais tu m'as sortie de cette léthargie, tu le sais, ça ?
russian:
Но ты меня

сами выдернули

сама выдернуласам выдернулсамо выдернуло.
bulgarian: But you shook me out of that, didn't you?

english: Elsie has been over the moon that we married, you know.
french: Elsie est ravie de notre mariage.
russian: Знаешь, Элси просто на седьмом небе с тех пор, как мы поженились.
bulgarian: Elsie has been over the moon that we married, you know.

english: To everyone else I must play the role of doctor...
french: Je dois jouer mon rôle de docteure aux yeux de tout le monde...
russian: Со всеми остальными я обязана играть роль врача...
bulgarian: To everyone else I must play the role of doctor...

english: But with you, I can simply be Valen.
french: Mais avec toi, je peux être Valen, tout simplement.
russian: А с тобой я могу просто быть Вален.
bulgarian: But with you, I can simply be Valen.

english: It's wonderful to know I can be loved for the other parts of myself.
french: C'est merveilleux de savoir qu'on m'aime pour d'autres aspects de ma personnalité.
russian: Знать, что я любима не только за эту часть меня — это прекрасное чувство.
bulgarian: It's wonderful to know I can be loved for the other parts of myself.

english: I find your company so relaxing, [Ari].
french: Ta présence est si apaisante, [Ari].
russian: Мне так спокойно рядом с тобой, [Ari].
bulgarian: I find your company so relaxing, [Ari].

english: Hmm... yes.
french: Hmm... oui.
russian: Хмм... Да.
bulgarian: Hmm... yes.

english: And being able to tell you so directly... this facet of marriage is quite gratifying.
french: Et le fait de pouvoir te le dire sans détour, c'est un aspect du mariage que j'apprécie énormément.
russian: И могу не стесняясь говорить об этом прямо в лицо... Мне нравится, что брак даёт такую возможность.
bulgarian: And being able to tell you so directly... this facet of marriage is quite gratifying.

english: There is something about you, today.
french: Tu as quelque chose de spécial, aujourd'hui.
russian: Сегодня в тебе что-то есть.
bulgarian: There is something about you, today.

english: Something?
french: Quelque chose de spécial ?
russian: И что же?
bulgarian: Something?

english: I was thinking the same about you.
french: Je me disais la même chose de toi.
russian:
Я

хотели

хотелахотелхотело то же сказать про тебя.
bulgarian: I was thinking the same about you.

english: Yes...
french: En effet...
russian: Нечто...
bulgarian: Yes...

english: For all the clinical vocabulary I have at my disposal, I'm having difficulty articulating it.
french: Malgré tout le vocabulaire médical à ma disposition, j'ai du mal à mettre des mots dessus.
russian: Несмотря на обширный запас медицинских терминов, мне трудно подыскать слова.
bulgarian: For all the clinical vocabulary I have at my disposal, I'm having difficulty articulating it.

english: I feel especially attracted to you in this moment.
french: Je ressens une attirance singulièrement forte envers toi, à ce moment précis.
russian: Я чувствую особое влечение к тебе прямо сейчас.
bulgarian: I feel especially attracted to you in this moment.

english: And being able to tell you so directly... this facet of marriage is quite gratifying.
french: Et le fait de pouvoir te le dire sans détour, c'est un aspect du mariage que j'apprécie énormément.
russian: И могу не стесняясь говорить об этом прямо в лицо... Мне нравится, что брак даёт такую возможность.
bulgarian: And being able to tell you so directly... this facet of marriage is quite gratifying.

english: Then perhaps you can find the words for it that elude me.
french: Tu parviendras peut-être alors à mettre des mots là où j'ai échoué.
russian: В таком случае, быть может, ты опишешь, что я имею в виду.
bulgarian: Then perhaps you can find the words for it that elude me.

english: For all the clinical vocabulary I have at my disposal, I'm having difficulty articulating it.
french: Malgré tout le vocabulaire médical à ma disposition, j'ai du mal à mettre des mots dessus.
russian: Несмотря на обширный запас медицинских терминов, мне трудно подыскать слова.
bulgarian: For all the clinical vocabulary I have at my disposal, I'm having difficulty articulating it.

english: I feel especially attracted to you in this moment.
french: Je ressens une attirance singulièrement forte envers toi, à ce moment précis.
russian: Я чувствую особое влечение к тебе прямо сейчас.
bulgarian: I feel especially attracted to you in this moment.

english: [Ari], stop right there.
french: [Ari], pas un pas de plus.
russian: [Ari], остановись.
bulgarian: [Ari], stop right there.

english: But that's absurd. Everything I've done in my life has led me to today's self.
french: Mais c'est absurde. Car tout ce que j'ai vécu jusqu'ici a fait de moi la personne que je suis aujourd'hui.
russian: Но это вздор. Благодаря моим поступкам я стала такой, какая есть сейчас.
bulgarian: But that's absurd. Everything I've done in my life has led me to today's self.

english: Even the foolish and callous things.
french: Même les choses stupides et inconsidérées.
russian: В том числе грубым и безрассудным поступкам.
bulgarian: Even the foolish and callous things.

english: I got all those things done and over with before I met you. Today, you have a far better version of me.
french: J'ai tourné la page sur tout ça avant de te connaître. Aujourd'hui, c'est une autre Valen qui se tient devant toi.
russian: Я пережила всё это задолго до нашей встречи с тобой. И теперь у тебя есть лучшая версия меня.
bulgarian: I got all those things done and over with before I met you. Today, you have a far better version of me.

english: And even now, we can shape each other into the best versions of ourselves. Who knows how wonderful our future will be?
french: Et ensemble, nous continuerons à nous améliorer. Qui sait quel avenir merveilleux nous attend ?
russian: Даже сейчас мы можем делать друг друга лучше и лучше. Какое же прекрасное будущее нас ждёт!
bulgarian: And even now, we can shape each other into the best versions of ourselves. Who knows how wonderful our future will be?

english: I recently caught myself wishing I'd met you when I was younger...
french: Récemment, je me disais que j'aurais bien aimé te rencontrer un peu plus jeune...
russian: Недавно я поймала себя на мысли, что хотела бы встретить тебя, когда была моложе...
bulgarian: I recently caught myself wishing I'd met you when I was younger...

english: But I worry about the risks you take, at times...
french: Il n'empêche que je m'inquiète parfois des risques que tu prends.
russian: Но временами меня пугает, на какие риски ты идёшь...
bulgarian: But I worry about the risks you take, at times...

english: Here, take this. It will help you if you need to get home quickly.
french: Tiens, prends ça. Ça te ramènera chez toi rapidement.
russian: Вот, возьми. Пригодится, если захочешь быстро добраться до дома.
bulgarian: Here, take this. It will help you if you need to get home quickly.

english: You know where to find me if you need more!
french: Tu sais où me trouver s'il t'en faut plus.
russian: Если понадобится ещё, ты знаешь, где меня найти!
bulgarian: You know where to find me if you need more!

english: Particularly all the delving into the depths of the Mines that you do.
french: Surtout quand tu pars t'aventurer dans les profondeurs des mines.
russian: Особенно, когда забираешься глубоко в шахты.
bulgarian: Particularly all the delving into the depths of the Mines that you do.

english: Well, I don't get injured THAT often...
french: Je ne me blesse pas si souvent que ça.
russian: Ну, я не НАСТОЛЬКО уж часто получаю ранения...
bulgarian: Well, I don't get injured THAT often...

english: Well, I don't pass out on my way home THAT often...
french: Je ne tombe pas si souvent dans les pommes que ça sur le chemin de la maison.
russian: Ну, я не НАСТОЛЬКО уж часто падаю в обморок по дороге домой...
bulgarian: Well, I don't pass out on my way home THAT often...

russian: Ох, [Ari]...
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]...

french: Je ne t'empêcherai jamais de faire ce que tu aimes, mais...
russian: Я, конечно, буду тебе мешать...
bulgarian: I certainly won't stand in your way, but-

russian: Вот, возьми. Пригодится, если будешь в опасности.

english: Whenever I see you, I experience a flood of endorphins.
french: Chaque fois que je te vois, j'ai un pic d'endorphines.
russian: Когда я вижу тебя, я испытываю приток эндорфинов.
bulgarian: Whenever I see you, I experience a flood of endorphins.

english: It seems that being near you is quite literally good for my health.
french: Il semblerait qu'être à côté de toi a un effet bénéfique sur ma santé.
russian: Кажется, что находиться рядом с тобой мне буквально полезно для здоровья.
bulgarian: It seems that being near you is quite literally good for my health.

english: So... I hope to see you often.
french: Donc... j'espère te voir très souvent.
russian: Так что... Надеюсь видеть тебя почаще.
bulgarian: So... I hope to see you often.

english: Hmm...
french: Hmm...
russian: Хмм...
bulgarian: Hmm...

english: It would make me happy if you bought yourself something nice.
french: Ça me ferait plaisir si un jour, tu te faisais un petit cadeau.
russian: Купи себе что-нибудь красивое. А я порадуюсь за тебя.
bulgarian: It would make me happy if you bought yourself something nice.

english: I noticed you window-shopping at the last Saturday Market...
french: J'ai remarqué que tu flânais au marché l'autre samedi...
russian: Я заметила, как ты глядишь на витрины на Субботнем базаре...
bulgarian: I noticed you window-shopping at the last Saturday Market...

english: And then reviewing my patient files to see if I can glean anything useful.
french: Ensuite, j'épluche les dossiers de mes patients pour voir si je trouve quelque chose d'utile.
russian: Затем я просматриваю записи своих пациентов и смотрю, не найдётся ли что-то полезное.
bulgarian: And then reviewing my patient files to see if I can glean anything useful.

english: But lately, I find myself quite distracted.
french: Mais j'ai la tête ailleurs en ce moment.
russian: Но в последнее время я обнаружила, что стала чаще отвлекаться.
bulgarian: But lately, I find myself quite distracted.

english: By thoughts of you, actually.
french: Parce que je pense à toi.
russian: На мысли о тебе.
bulgarian: By thoughts of you, actually.

english: I'm... not complaining.
french: Non que je me plaigne.
russian: И я... не жалуюсь.
bulgarian: I'm... not complaining.

english: A large part of my day is reading the medical journals that come in from the Capital-
french: Je passe une partie de mes journées à lire les revues médicales que je reçois de la capitale.
russian: Значительная часть моего рабочего дня уходит на чтение медицинских журналов из столицы...
bulgarian: A large part of my day is reading the medical journals that come in from the Capital-

english: I wouldn't say I feel "old" by any means.
french: Je ne dirais pas pour autant que je suis « vieille ».
russian: Я нисколько не чувствую себя «старой».
bulgarian: I wouldn't say I feel "old" by any means.

english: But around you, I'm given to feeling... youthful.
french: Mais, quand tu es là, je prends comme un coup de jeune.
russian: Но рядом с тобой я начинаю ощущать... молодость.
bulgarian: But around you, I'm given to feeling... youthful.

english: While I've been around long enough to have a fair bit of experience...
french: J'ai vécu assez longtemps pour avoir une certaine expérience...
russian: Хотя я уже достаточно пожила и накопила определённый опыт...
bulgarian: While I've been around long enough to have a fair bit of experience...

english: They are very observant, aren't they? And lacking a filter.
french: Ils sont très observateurs, pas vrai ? Et sans filtre.
russian: Какие же они наблюдательные! И прямолинейные.
bulgarian: They are very observant, aren't they? And lacking a filter.

english: I was engrossed in my paperwork, but I admit my mind was elsewhere.
french: J'étais plongée dans mes dossiers, mais je reconnais que j'avais la tête ailleurs.
russian: Я была погружена в бумаги, но не заметила и замечталась.
bulgarian: I was engrossed in my paperwork, but I admit my mind was elsewhere.

english: Dell made a point of teasing me for blushing.
french: Dell m'a asticotée parce qu'elle m'a vue rougir.
russian: Делл нарочно начала дразниться, что я краснею.
bulgarian: Dell made a point of teasing me for blushing.

english: And then Luc and Maple followed suit!
french: Et Luc et Maple s'y sont mis aussi !
russian: А Люк и Мэйпл стали за ней повторять!
bulgarian: And then Luc and Maple followed suit!

english: Truthfully... I'd been thinking of you, if you must know.
french: Pour tout te dire... c'est à toi que je pensais.
russian: Честно говоря... Я думала о тебе, если вдруг интересно.
bulgarian: Truthfully... I'd been thinking of you, if you must know.

english: The children stopped by the Clinic the other day.
french: Les enfants sont passés à la clinique l'autre jour.
russian: На днях в клинику заходили дети.
bulgarian: The children stopped by the Clinic the other day.
